lpp.ach_return.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ach_return.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each ACH return record.

lpp.ach_return.original_transfer_ref.name: original_transfer_ref
lpp.ach_return.original_transfer_ref.description: Reference identifier of the original ACH transfer that was subsequently returned.

lpp.ach_return.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ach_return.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or company associated with the ACH return, such as a country-specific subsidiary or treasury entity.

lpp.ach_return.business_unit_code.name: business_unit_code
lpp.ach_return.business_unit_code.description: Code identifying the business unit responsible for the ACH return, typically aligned to a country or functional division.
value_aliases: BU_USINC_PAYROLL -> Business Unit US Inc Payroll

lpp.ach_return.return_date.name: return_date
lpp.ach_return.return_date.description: The calendar date on which the ACH return was received or processed.

lpp.ach_return.return_reason_code.name: return_reason_code
lpp.ach_return.return_reason_code.description: Standardized NACHA return reason code indicating the specific cause of the ACH return, such as R01 for insufficient funds.
value_aliases: R03 -> No Account / Unable to Locate Account
R29 -> Corporate Customer Advises Not Authorized

lpp.ach_return.return_category.name: return_category
lpp.ach_return.return_category.description: High-level grouping of the return reason, classifying ACH returns into categories such as insufficient funds, invalid account, unauthorized, or other.

lpp.ach_return.direction.name: direction
lpp.ach_return.direction.description: Indicates the direction of the ACH return transaction, currently always a debit movement.

lpp.ach_return.amount.name: amount
lpp.ach_return.amount.description: The monetary value of the returned ACH transaction in the associated currency.

lpp.ach_return.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ach_return.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the returned ACH transaction amount is denominated.

lpp.ach_return.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.ach_return.bank_account_ref.description: Reference identifier for the bank account associated with the ACH return, indicating the specific operating or payroll account affected.

lpp.ach_return.resolved.name: resolved
lpp.ach_return.resolved.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ACH return has been resolved or addressed by the business.

lpp.acquirer.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each acquirer record.

lpp.acquirer.code.name: code
lpp.acquirer.code.description: Short internal code used to uniquely identify a payment acquirer, such as ADYEN or STRIPE.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer.name.name: name
lpp.acquirer.name.description: Full legal or trade name of the payment acquirer, such as 'Adyen NV' or 'Stripe Payments'.

lpp.acquirer.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.acquirer.bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the sponsoring or affiliated bank associated with the acquirer, where applicable (e.g., BANK_JPM for JPMorgan Chase).

lpp.acquirer.settlement_account_ref.name: settlement_account_ref
lpp.acquirer.settlement_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the internal settlement account used to receive funds from this acquirer (e.g., USA_RGNL_OPERATING for US regional operating account).
value_aliases: GR_US_INC_OP_4 -> Group US Inc Operating Account 4

lpp.acquirer.region.name: region
lpp.acquirer.region.description: Geographic region in which the acquirer operates, such as Americas (AMER) or Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA).

lpp.acquirer.is_strategic.name: is_strategic
lpp.acquirer.is_strategic.description: Flag indicating whether the acquirer is classified as a strategic partner for the business.

lpp.acquirer.onboarded_date.name: onboarded_date
lpp.acquirer.onboarded_date.description: Calendar date on which the acquirer was formally onboarded and activated for payment processing.

lpp.acquirer_contract.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer_contract.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each acquirer contract record.

lpp.acquirer_contract.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.acquirer_contract.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the payment acquirer or processor party to the contract, such as Adyen, Stripe, or FIS Worldpay.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer_contract.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.acquirer_contract.company_ref.description: Code identifying the internal legal entity or subsidiary that is party to the acquirer contract, such as the US, EU, APAC, Canadian, or UK entity.

lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_from.description: Date on which the acquirer contract becomes effective and terms begin to apply.

lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_to.description: Date on which the acquirer contract expires or is terminated; null indicates an open-ended contract.

lpp.acquirer_contract.contract_status.name: contract_status
lpp.acquirer_contract.contract_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the acquirer contract, indicating whether it is active or otherwise.

lpp.acquirer_contract.processor_margin_b.name: processor_margin_bps
lpp.acquirer_contract.processor_margin_b.description: The acquirer or processor's margin charged on transactions, expressed in basis points.

lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_am.name: monthly_minimum_amount
lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_am.description: The minimum monthly fee amount guaranteed to the acquirer under the contract terms.

lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_cu.name: monthly_minimum_currency
lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_cu.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the monthly minimum fee amount is denominated, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_lag_bus.name: settlement_lag_business_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_lag_bus.description: Number of business days between transaction processing and funds settlement under the contract.

lpp.acquirer_contract.uptime_sla_pct.name: uptime_sla_pct
lpp.acquirer_contract.uptime_sla_pct.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum platform uptime for the acquirer, expressed as a percentage.

lpp.acquirer_contract.auth_response_sla_.name: auth_response_sla_ms
lpp.acquirer_contract.auth_response_sla_.description: Maximum authorization response time guaranteed by the acquirer under the contract's SLA, measured in milliseconds.

lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_sla_bus.name: settlement_sla_business_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_sla_bus.description: Contractually committed maximum number of business days within which the acquirer must complete settlement.

lpp.acquirer_contract.renewal_notice_day.name: renewal_notice_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.renewal_notice_day.description: Number of days advance notice required before contract expiry to trigger or prevent automatic renewal.

lpp.acquirer_contract.auto_renew.name: auto_renew
lpp.acquirer_contract.auto_renew.description: Flag indicating whether the acquirer contract automatically renews at the end of its term.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each SLA metric record for deduplication and system-level tracking.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.acquirer_ref.description: Short code identifying the payment acquirer or processor (e.g., STRIPE, ADYEN, FISERV) whose SLA performance is being measured.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.measurement_date.name: measurement_date
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.measurement_date.description: The calendar date on which the SLA metrics for the acquirer were recorded or aggregated.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.auth_rate_pct.name: auth_rate_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.auth_rate_pct.description: The percentage of payment authorisation requests that were successfully approved by the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.avg_response_tim.name: avg_response_time_ms
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.avg_response_tim.description: The average time in milliseconds taken by the acquirer to respond to transaction requests on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.settlement_on_ti.name: settlement_on_time_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.settlement_on_ti.description: The percentage of settlements completed by the acquirer within the agreed contractual timeframe on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uptime_pct.name: uptime_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uptime_pct.description: The percentage of time the acquirer's payment processing systems were available and operational on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.sla_breach_count.name: sla_breach_count
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.sla_breach_count.description: The number of distinct SLA contractual breaches recorded against the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.incident_count.name: incident_count
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.incident_count.description: The number of operational incidents or outages reported for the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.ap_invoice.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ap_invoice.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each accounts payable invoice record.

lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_number.name: invoice_number
lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_number.description: Human-readable reference number assigned to each accounts payable invoice, following the AP-XXXXXXXX format.

lpp.ap_invoice.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ap_invoice.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary of the group that received and is responsible for paying the invoice (e.g., GR_US_INC, GR_FR).

lpp.ap_invoice.vendor_ref.name: vendor_ref
lpp.ap_invoice.vendor_ref.description: Code identifying the supplier or vendor who issued the invoice, with the prefix indicating the spend category (e.g., TP_CAPEX, TP_IT, TP_MKTG).

lpp.ap_invoice.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.ap_invoice.issue_date.description: The date on which the vendor issued the invoice.

lpp.ap_invoice.due_date.name: due_date
lpp.ap_invoice.due_date.description: The date by which payment of the invoice must be made to the vendor.

lpp.ap_invoice.paid_date.name: paid_date
lpp.ap_invoice.paid_date.description: The date on which the invoice was actually paid; null when the invoice has not yet been paid.

lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_amount.name: invoice_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_amount.description: The total monetary amount billed on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.paid_amount.name: paid_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.paid_amount.description: The monetary amount that has been paid against the invoice to date, in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.open_amount.name: open_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.open_amount.description: The outstanding monetary balance remaining unpaid on the invoice, in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ap_invoice.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

lpp.ap_invoice.status.name: status
lpp.ap_invoice.status.description: The current processing status of the invoice, indicating whether it has been paid or is under dispute.

lpp.ap_invoice.payment_terms.name: payment_terms
lpp.ap_invoice.payment_terms.description: The agreed payment terms specifying when payment is due relative to the invoice date (e.g., NET_30 means payment due within 30 days, EOM_5 means 5 days after end of month).
value_aliases: EOM_5 -> 5 days after end of month

lpp.app_user.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.app_user.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each application user record.

lpp.app_user.code.name: code
lpp.app_user.code.description: Short alphanumeric role or persona code assigned to the user, representing their functional role and regional scope within the organization (e.g., CASH_MANAGER_APAC, FX_TRADER).
value_aliases: CASH_MANAGER_EMEA -> Cash Manager – Europe Middle East Africa

lpp.app_user.first_name.name: first_name
lpp.app_user.first_name.description: The given (first) name of the application user.

lpp.app_user.last_name.name: last_name
lpp.app_user.last_name.description: The family (last) name or surname of the application user.

lpp.app_user.email.name: email
lpp.app_user.email.description: Corporate email address of the application user, following the firstname.lastname@globalretail.com format.

lpp.app_user.active.name: active
lpp.app_user.active.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the application user account is currently active and enabled.

lpp.ar_invoice.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ar_invoice.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each accounts receivable invoice record.

lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_number.name: invoice_number
lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_number.description: Human-readable invoice reference number, typically encoding the business channel, company entity, and issue date (e.g., AR-B2C-GR_APAC_PTE-20230501).

lpp.ar_invoice.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ar_invoice.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary of the company that issued the invoice (e.g., GR_FR, GR_US_INC, GR_APAC_PTE).

lpp.ar_invoice.customer_ref.name: customer_ref
lpp.ar_invoice.customer_ref.description: Code identifying the customer or buyer on the invoice, including retail consumers and third-party customers (e.g., RETAIL_CONSUMER, TP_CUST_0015).

lpp.ar_invoice.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.ar_invoice.issue_date.description: The date on which the invoice was created and issued to the customer.

lpp.ar_invoice.due_date.name: due_date
lpp.ar_invoice.due_date.description: The date by which payment of the invoice is expected from the customer.

lpp.ar_invoice.paid_date.name: paid_date
lpp.ar_invoice.paid_date.description: The date on which the invoice was fully paid; null when the invoice has not yet been paid.

lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_amount.name: invoice_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_amount.description: The total monetary amount billed to the customer on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.paid_amount.name: paid_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.paid_amount.description: The monetary amount that has been received as payment against the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.open_amount.name: open_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.open_amount.description: The outstanding monetary amount still owed by the customer on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ar_invoice.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the invoice amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

lpp.ar_invoice.status.name: status
lpp.ar_invoice.status.description: Current collection status of the invoice, indicating whether it has been paid, remains open, or has been written off as uncollectible.

lpp.ar_invoice.payment_terms.name: payment_terms
lpp.ar_invoice.payment_terms.description: Agreed payment terms specifying the number of days the customer has to pay the invoice after the issue date (e.g., NET_30 means payment due within 30 days).

lpp.audit_trail.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.audit_trail.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each audit trail event record.

lpp.audit_trail.entity_type.name: entity_type
lpp.audit_trail.entity_type.description: The category of business object that was acted upon, such as a bank account, transfer, hedge relationship, or liquidity policy.

lpp.audit_trail.entity_code.name: entity_code
lpp.audit_trail.entity_code.description: The business code identifying the specific entity instance that was acted upon, such as a particular bank account or transfer.

lpp.audit_trail.action.name: action
lpp.audit_trail.action.description: The type of operation performed on the entity, indicating whether it was created, updated, or approved.

lpp.audit_trail.actor_user.name: actor_user
lpp.audit_trail.actor_user.description: The username or system role of the user who performed the audited action, such as a treasury administrator or CFO.

lpp.audit_trail.occurred_at.name: occurred_at
lpp.audit_trail.occurred_at.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the audited action took place.

lpp.audit_trail.before_image.name: before_image
lpp.audit_trail.before_image.description: A snapshot of the entity's full data state immediately before the action was performed, enabling change comparison.

lpp.audit_trail.after_image.name: after_image
lpp.audit_trail.after_image.description: A snapshot of the entity's full data state immediately after the action was performed, capturing the resulting changes.

lpp.bank.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bank record.

lpp.bank.code.name: code
lpp.bank.code.description: Internal alphanumeric code used to identify a bank within the system, such as BANK_JPM for JPMorgan Chase or BANK_HSBC for HSBC.

lpp.bank.interface_code.name: interface_code
lpp.bank.interface_code.description: Code used to identify the bank in external system integrations and interfaces, mirroring the internal bank code such as BANK_CITI or BANK_MUFG.

lpp.bank.external_code.name: external_code
lpp.bank.external_code.description: Code assigned by an external party or system to identify the bank.

lpp.bank.description1.name: description1
lpp.bank.description1.description: Primary human-readable name of the bank, such as 'JPMorgan Chase' or 'BNP Paribas'.

lpp.bank.description2.name: description2
lpp.bank.description2.description: Secondary or supplementary descriptive label for the bank, providing additional naming detail.

lpp.bank.bic.name: bic
lpp.bank.bic.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC/SWIFT code) used for international interbank transactions, such as BNPAFRPP for BNP Paribas or CHASUS33 for JPMorgan Chase.

lpp.bank.lei.name: lei
lpp.bank.lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) assigned to the bank for regulatory reporting and identification purposes.

lpp.bank.url_address.name: url_address
lpp.bank.url_address.description: Website URL associated with the bank for reference or portal access.

lpp.bank.contact.name: contact
lpp.bank.contact.description: Contact information for the bank relationship, such as a representative name or phone number.

lpp.bank.intercompany.name: intercompany
lpp.bank.intercompany.description: Flag indicating whether the bank is classified as an intercompany entity within the corporate group.

lpp.bank.internal_counterparty.name: internal_counterparty
lpp.bank.internal_counterparty.description: Flag indicating whether the bank is treated as an internal counterparty for treasury or settlement purposes.

lpp.bank.counter_party_info.name: counter_party_info
lpp.bank.counter_party_info.description: Flag indicating whether counterparty information is available or required for transactions with this bank.

lpp.bank.intermediary_info.name: intermediary_info
lpp.bank.intermediary_info.description: Flag indicating whether intermediary bank information is available or required for payments to this bank.

lpp.bank.net_settlements.name: net_settlements
lpp.bank.net_settlements.description: Flag indicating whether transactions with this bank are settled on a net basis rather than gross.

lpp.bank.net_debit_and_credit_exposure.name: net_debit_and_credit_exposure
lpp.bank.net_debit_and_credit_exposure.description: Flag indicating whether debit and credit exposures to this bank are netted for risk or reporting purposes.

lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_amount.name: cash_exposure_limit_amount
lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_amount.description: Maximum monetary amount of cash exposure permitted for this bank, used for credit or counterparty risk management.

lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_currency.name: cash_exposure_limit_currency
lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_currency.description: Currency in which the cash exposure limit amount is denominated, currently USD for all records.

lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_pct.name: cash_exposure_limit_pct
lpp.bank.cash_exposure_limit_pct.description: Maximum allowable cash exposure to this bank expressed as a percentage of a portfolio or total exposure baseline.

lpp.bank.deal_identifier.name: deal_identifier
lpp.bank.deal_identifier.description: Code or label used to identify or prefix deals associated with this bank in transaction records.

lpp.bank.fx_confirmation_method.name: fx_confirmation_method
lpp.bank.fx_confirmation_method.description: Method used to confirm FX transactions with this bank, such as electronic messaging or manual confirmation.

lpp.bank.loan_confirmation_method.name: loan_confirmation_method
lpp.bank.loan_confirmation_method.description: Method used to confirm loan transactions or facilities with this bank.

lpp.bank.risk_tier_ref.name: risk_tier_ref
lpp.bank.risk_tier_ref.description: Risk tier classification assigned to the bank indicating its relative credit or counterparty risk level, such as TIER_1 (lowest risk) through TIER_3 (highest risk).

lpp.bank.parent_counterparty_ref.name: parent_counterparty_ref
lpp.bank.parent_counterparty_ref.description: Reference to the parent counterparty entity that this bank belongs to for grouping or hierarchy purposes.

lpp.bank.default_group_ref.name: default_group_ref
lpp.bank.default_group_ref.description: Reference to the default group that this bank is assigned to for reporting or organizational purposes.

lpp.bank.third_party_ref.name: third_party_ref
lpp.bank.third_party_ref.description: Reference to an associated third-party entity linked to this bank record.

lpp.bank.address.name: address
lpp.bank.address.description: Structured address details of the bank, stored as a JSON or semi-structured object.

lpp.bank.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.bank.user_zones.description: Semi-structured data defining the user access zones or regional permissions associated with this bank.

lpp.bank_account.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_account.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each bank account record.

lpp.bank_account.code.name: code
lpp.bank_account.code.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying a bank account, typically encoding the legal entity, region, and account purpose (e.g., GR_AE_PAYROLL_1).

lpp.bank_account.description.name: description
lpp.bank_account.description.description: Human-readable name of the bank account that describes the legal entity, location, and account purpose (e.g., GR_AE PAYROLL Account).

lpp.bank_account.description2.name: description2
lpp.bank_account.description2.description: Secondary descriptive label for the bank account, providing an additional free-text name or annotation.

lpp.bank_account.account_type.name: account_type
lpp.bank_account.account_type.description: Classification of the record type, indicating that all entries in this table represent bank accounts (value: BANK_ACCOUNT).

lpp.bank_account.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.bank_account.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the bank account is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD).

lpp.bank_account.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.bank_account.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that owns the bank account (e.g., GR_AE, GR_AU, GR_EU_BV).

lpp.bank_account.branch_ref.name: branch_ref
lpp.bank_account.branch_ref.description: Code identifying the bank branch where the account is held, typically encoding the bank name and city (e.g., BR_HSBC_SG, BR_CITI_NY).

lpp.bank_account.default_group_ref.name: default_group_ref
lpp.bank_account.default_group_ref.description: Code referencing the default account group or pool to which this bank account belongs.

lpp.bank_account.bank_account_id.name: bank_account_id
lpp.bank_account.bank_account_id.description: Structured object storing one or more external bank account identifiers such as IBAN or account number.

lpp.bank_account.bank_account_ids.name: bank_account_ids
lpp.bank_account.bank_account_ids.description: Structured collection of all external bank account identifiers associated with the account (e.g., IBAN, BBAN, routing numbers).

lpp.bank_account.address.name: address
lpp.bank_account.address.description: Structured object containing the postal address associated with the bank account.

lpp.bank_account.contact.name: contact
lpp.bank_account.contact.description: Structured object storing contact details (e.g., phone, email) for the bank account relationship manager or account officer.

lpp.bank_account.calendar_ref.name: calendar_ref
lpp.bank_account.calendar_ref.description: Code identifying the business calendar applied to the bank account for settlement and value-date calculations (e.g., STANDARD).

lpp.bank_account.time_zone.name: time_zone
lpp.bank_account.time_zone.description: Time zone used for the bank account's transaction and cut-off time calculations (e.g., UTC).

lpp.bank_account.cut_off_time.name: cut_off_time
lpp.bank_account.cut_off_time.description: Daily cut-off time after which transactions are processed on the next business day for this bank account.

lpp.bank_account.opening_date.name: opening_date
lpp.bank_account.opening_date.description: Date on which the bank account was opened, with values observed from 2017 to 2019.

lpp.bank_account.closing_date.name: closing_date
lpp.bank_account.closing_date.description: Date on which the bank account was or is scheduled to be closed; null for the majority of active accounts.

lpp.bank_account.closed_account.name: closed_account
lpp.bank_account.closed_account.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the bank account has been closed (True) or is still active (False).

lpp.bank_account.hidden.name: hidden
lpp.bank_account.hidden.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the bank account is hidden from standard user views in the treasury system.

lpp.bank_account.non_resident.name: non_resident
lpp.bank_account.non_resident.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the bank account is classified as a non-resident account for regulatory or tax purposes.

lpp.bank_account.bank_statement_layout.name: bank_statement_layout
lpp.bank_account.bank_statement_layout.description: Code or template name defining the expected format of bank statements imported for this account.

lpp.bank_account.integrate_end_of_day_st.name: integrate_end_of_day_statements
lpp.bank_account.integrate_end_of_day_st.description: Boolean flag indicating whether end-of-day bank statements are automatically integrated into the treasury system for this account.

lpp.bank_account.integrate_intraday_stat.name: integrate_intraday_statements
lpp.bank_account.integrate_intraday_stat.description: Boolean flag indicating whether intraday bank statements are automatically integrated into the treasury system for this account.

lpp.bank_account.consider_one_day_float_.name: consider_one_day_float_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_one_day_float_.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transactions with a one-day float are included in cash position calculations for this account.

lpp.bank_account.consider_two_day_float_.name: consider_two_day_float_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_two_day_float_.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transactions with a two-day float are included in cash position calculations for this account.

lpp.bank_account.consider_three_day_floa.name: consider_three_day_float_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_three_day_floa.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transactions with a three-day float are included in cash position calculations for this account.

lpp.bank_account.consider_investment_pos.name: consider_investment_position_transactions
lpp.bank_account.consider_investment_pos.description: Boolean flag indicating whether investment position transactions are included in the cash position calculations for this account.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.eligible_spend.name: eligible_spend
lpp.card_rebate_earning.eligible_spend.description: The total monetary amount of card spend that qualifies for rebate calculation within the period.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.rebate_earned.name: rebate_earned
lpp.card_rebate_earning.rebate_earned.description: The monetary value of the rebate earned based on eligible card spend for the reporting period.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.card_rebate_earning.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code denoting the currency in which the eligible spend and rebate amounts are expressed.

lpp.card_rebate_earning.tier_achieved.name: tier_achieved
lpp.card_rebate_earning.tier_achieved.description: The rebate tier level attained based on spend volume within the program, determining the applicable rebate rate.

lpp.card_rebate_program.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_rebate_program.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card rebate program record.

lpp.card_rebate_program.code.name: code
lpp.card_rebate_program.code.description: Short alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a card rebate program, typically encoding the issuer and card type (e.g., REB_JPM_VCARD for JPMorgan Virtual Card).

lpp.card_rebate_program.issuer_bank_ref.name: issuer_bank_ref
lpp.card_rebate_program.issuer_bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank that issues the card associated with this rebate program (e.g., BANK_JPM for JPMorgan, BANK_CITI for Citibank).

lpp.card_rebate_program.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.card_rebate_program.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the corporate entity enrolled in this card rebate program (e.g., GR_HOLDINGS, GR_US_INC).

lpp.card_rebate_program.program_type.name: program_type
lpp.card_rebate_program.program_type.description: Category of the card rebate program indicating the type of corporate payment card used, such as Purchasing Card, Virtual Card, or Commercial Card.

lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_tier_thre.name: rebate_tier_threshold
lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_tier_thre.description: Minimum spend amount that must be reached to qualify for the rebate tier under this program.

lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_bps_at_ta.name: rebate_bps_at_target
lpp.card_rebate_program.rebate_bps_at_ta.description: Rebate rate expressed in basis points awarded to the company when the target spend threshold is achieved under this program.

lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_from.description: Date from which this card rebate program becomes active and eligible for rebate accrual.

lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.card_rebate_program.effective_to.description: Date on which this card rebate program expires and is no longer eligible for rebate accrual.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_settlement_batch.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each card settlement batch record.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.card_settlement_batch.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the acquiring bank or payment processor that processed and settled the batch (e.g., FISERV, STRIPE, BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS).
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_code.name: network_code
lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_code.description: Code identifying the card network or payment scheme over which the batch transactions were routed (e.g., VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX).

lpp.card_settlement_batch.settlement_cur.name: settlement_currency
lpp.card_settlement_batch.settlement_cur.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the batch was settled with the acquirer (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

lpp.card_settlement_batch.batch_close_ts.name: batch_close_ts
lpp.card_settlement_batch.batch_close_ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the settlement batch was officially closed by the merchant or point-of-sale system.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_sett.name: processor_settle_ts
lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_sett.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment processor completed settlement of the batch on their end.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_deposit_t.name: bank_deposit_ts
lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_deposit_t.description: Timestamp indicating when the net settlement funds were deposited into the merchant's bank account.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_account_r.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.card_settlement_batch.bank_account_r.description: Reference code identifying the destination bank account into which the settlement funds were deposited (e.g., USA_RGNL_OPERATING).
value_aliases: GR_US_INC_OP_4 -> GR US Inc Operating Account 4

lpp.card_settlement_batch.gross_sales_am.name: gross_sales_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.gross_sales_am.description: Total gross sales value of all transactions included in the settlement batch before any deductions.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.refund_amount.name: refund_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.refund_amount.description: Total value of refunds and credits included in the settlement batch, reducing the net payout.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.chargeback_amo.name: chargeback_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.chargeback_amo.description: Total monetary value of chargebacks disputed and deducted within the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.interchange_am.name: interchange_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.interchange_am.description: Total interchange fees charged by the card networks and deducted from the batch settlement.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_assess.name: network_assessment_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.network_assess.description: Total card network assessment fees (e.g., scheme fees) deducted from the settlement batch by the card network.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_marg.name: processor_margin_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.processor_marg.description: Total margin or markup fee charged by the payment processor for handling the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.other_fees_amo.name: other_fees_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.other_fees_amo.description: Total of any miscellaneous or ancillary fees deducted from the settlement batch not captured in other fee categories.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.net_settlement.name: net_settlement_amount
lpp.card_settlement_batch.net_settlement.description: Final net amount deposited to the merchant after all fees, refunds, and chargebacks have been deducted from gross sales.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.transaction_co.name: transaction_count
lpp.card_settlement_batch.transaction_co.description: Number of individual card transactions included in the settlement batch.

lpp.card_settlement_batch.sla_met.name: sla_met
lpp.card_settlement_batch.sla_met.description: Flag indicating whether the settlement batch was processed within the agreed service level agreement timeframe.

lpp.card_settlement_line.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.card_settlement_line.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each card settlement line record.

lpp.card_settlement_line.batch_ref.name: batch_ref
lpp.card_settlement_line.batch_ref.description: Reference identifier for the settlement batch in which this line was processed.

lpp.card_settlement_line.authorization_r.name: authorization_ref
lpp.card_settlement_line.authorization_r.description: Reference identifier for the original card authorization associated with this settlement line.

lpp.card_settlement_line.gross_amount.name: gross_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.gross_amount.description: Total transaction amount before any fees or deductions are applied.

lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_amo.name: interchange_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_amo.description: The monetary value of interchange fees charged by the card-issuing bank for this settlement line.

lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_bps.name: interchange_bps
lpp.card_settlement_line.interchange_bps.description: Interchange fee expressed in basis points (hundredths of a percent) relative to the transaction amount.

lpp.card_settlement_line.network_assessm.name: network_assessment_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.network_assessm.description: Fee amount assessed by the card network (e.g., Visa, Mastercard) for processing this settlement line.

lpp.card_settlement_line.processor_margi.name: processor_margin_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.processor_margi.description: The monetary margin or markup retained by the payment processor for handling this settlement line.

lpp.card_settlement_line.other_fees_amou.name: other_fees_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.other_fees_amou.description: Aggregate of any miscellaneous or additional fees not captured in interchange, network, or processor margin amounts.

lpp.card_settlement_line.net_amount.name: net_amount
lpp.card_settlement_line.net_amount.description: The amount actually settled to the merchant after all fees and deductions have been subtracted from the gross amount.

lpp.card_settlement_line.issuer_country.name: issuer_country
lpp.card_settlement_line.issuer_country.description: ISO country code of the bank that issued the card used in the transaction (e.g., US, CN, DE).

lpp.card_settlement_line.cross_border.name: cross_border
lpp.card_settlement_line.cross_border.description: Indicates whether the transaction was cross-border, meaning the card issuer country differs from the merchant country.

lpp.card_settlement_line.dcc_applied.name: dcc_applied
lpp.card_settlement_line.dcc_applied.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Currency Conversion was applied, allowing the cardholder to pay in their home currency.

lpp.card_settlement_line.fx_rate_applied.name: fx_rate_applied
lpp.card_settlement_line.fx_rate_applied.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert the transaction amount when a currency conversion was performed.

lpp.cash_balance.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.cash_balance.account_ref.description: Unique coded reference identifying a bank account by entity, country, currency, and account purpose (e.g., payroll, collection, concentration, disbursement).

lpp.cash_balance.balance_date.name: balance_date
lpp.cash_balance.balance_date.description: The calendar date for which the cash balance is reported.

lpp.cash_balance.date_basis.name: date_basis
lpp.cash_balance.date_basis.description: Indicates whether the balance is calculated using the value date (funds availability) or the transaction date (booking date) of cash flows.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_actual.name: includes_actual
lpp.cash_balance.includes_actual.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes actual (posted) cash transactions.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_intraday.name: includes_intraday
lpp.cash_balance.includes_intraday.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes intraday (same-day, real-time) cash transactions.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_confirmed.name: includes_confirmed
lpp.cash_balance.includes_confirmed.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes confirmed (scheduled and verified) cash flows.

lpp.cash_balance.includes_estimated.name: includes_estimated
lpp.cash_balance.includes_estimated.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes estimated (forecast or unconfirmed) cash flows.

lpp.cash_balance.amount.name: amount
lpp.cash_balance.amount.description: The monetary cash balance for the account on the given date, expressed in the account's native currency.

lpp.cash_balance.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.cash_balance.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the cash balance amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.cash_balance.cash_flow_status.name: cash_flow_status
lpp.cash_balance.cash_flow_status.description: Indicates whether the cash flows contributing to this balance are confirmed (verified/scheduled) or estimated (forecast/unconfirmed).

lpp.cash_flow.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.cash_flow.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each cash flow record.

lpp.cash_flow.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.cash_flow.account_ref.description: Coded reference identifying the specific bank account involved in the cash flow, encoding the legal entity, country, and account purpose (e.g., collection, operating, concentration).

lpp.cash_flow.flow_code_ref.name: flow_code_ref
lpp.cash_flow.flow_code_ref.description: Standardised code classifying the nature and direction of the cash flow transaction, such as receipts, disbursements, sweeps, FX settlements, loan activity, or card transactions.
value_aliases: RCPT_AR_SEPA -> Accounts Receivable Receipt via SEPA
RCPT_AR_WIRE -> Accounts Receivable Receipt via Wire
DISB_AP_WIRE -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via Wire
DISB_AP_SEPA -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via SEPA
DISB_AP_ACH -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via ACH
RCPT_AR_ACH -> Accounts Receivable Receipt via ACH
DISB_AP_RTP -> Accounts Payable Disbursement via RTP

lpp.cash_flow.budget_code_ref.name: budget_code_ref
lpp.cash_flow.budget_code_ref.description: Budget classification code grouping the cash flow into a high-level budget category such as operations, treasury, tax, or capital expenditure.

lpp.cash_flow.status.name: status
lpp.cash_flow.status.description: Indicates whether the cash flow has been confirmed as an actual transaction or remains a forward-looking forecast.

lpp.cash_flow.transaction_date.name: transaction_date
lpp.cash_flow.transaction_date.description: The date on which the cash flow transaction was initiated or recorded.

lpp.cash_flow.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.cash_flow.value_date.description: The date on which the funds are effectively available or settled in the account.

lpp.cash_flow.update_date_time.name: update_date_time
lpp.cash_flow.update_date_time.description: Timestamp recording when the cash flow record was last created or modified in the system.

lpp.cash_flow.flow_amount.name: flow_amount
lpp.cash_flow.flow_amount.description: The gross monetary amount of the cash flow expressed in the flow's original transaction currency.

lpp.cash_flow.flow_currency.name: flow_currency
lpp.cash_flow.flow_currency.description: The ISO currency code in which the cash flow amount was originally denominated, such as EUR, USD, or JPY.

lpp.cash_flow.signed_amount.name: signed_amount
lpp.cash_flow.signed_amount.description: The cash flow amount with directionality applied, where positive values represent inflows and negative values represent outflows, in the flow currency.

lpp.cash_flow.account_amount.name: account_amount
lpp.cash_flow.account_amount.description: The cash flow amount converted into and expressed in the denomination currency of the associated bank account.

lpp.cash_flow.account_currency.name: account_currency
lpp.cash_flow.account_currency.description: The ISO currency code of the bank account in which the cash flow is recorded, reflecting the account's denomination currency.

lpp.cash_flow.fx_rate.name: fx_rate
lpp.cash_flow.fx_rate.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the flow currency amount into the account currency at the time of the transaction.

lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_name.name: counterparty_name
lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_name.description: The human-readable name of the external party involved in the cash flow, such as a vendor, retail consumer, payment service provider, or bank.

lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_ref.name: counterparty_ref
lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_ref.description: Unique coded reference identifying the counterparty involved in the cash flow, used for systematic lookup of vendors, customers, or payment providers.

lpp.cash_flow.description.name: description
lpp.cash_flow.description.description: Free-text narrative describing the purpose or nature of the cash flow, such as daily POS receipts, bank fees, sweep transactions, or FX forward settlements.

lpp.cash_flow.reference.name: reference
lpp.cash_flow.reference.description: External or source-system reference number associated with the cash flow, such as an FX forward contract number or a system-generated UUID.

lpp.cash_flow.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.cash_flow.user_zones.description: A structured data field capturing user-defined zone or segmentation tags associated with the cash flow record.

lpp.cash_flow.payment_rail.name: payment_rail
lpp.cash_flow.payment_rail.description: The payment infrastructure or network used to process the cash flow, such as WIRE, SEPA Credit Transfer, ACH, Real-Time Payments, or book transfer.

lpp.cash_flow_code.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.cash_flow_code.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each cash flow code record.

lpp.cash_flow_code.code.name: code
lpp.cash_flow_code.code.description: Short alphanumeric code representing a specific type of cash flow transaction, such as point-of-sale receipts, payroll disbursements, or intercompany funding.

lpp.cash_flow_code.description.name: description
lpp.cash_flow_code.description.description: Human-readable label explaining the business purpose of a cash flow code, such as 'Payroll', 'Tax payments', or 'Intercompany funding-in'.

lpp.cash_flow_code.sign.name: sign
lpp.cash_flow_code.sign.description: Indicates whether the cash flow represents money coming into the entity ('IN') or going out ('OUT').

lpp.cash_flow_code.category.name: category
lpp.cash_flow_code.category.description: Standard cash flow statement classification grouping transaction types into operating, investing, or financing activities.

lpp.chargeback.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.chargeback.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each chargeback record.

lpp.chargeback.authorization_ref.name: authorization_ref
lpp.chargeback.authorization_ref.description: UUID reference to the original payment authorization that was disputed in the chargeback.

lpp.chargeback.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.chargeback.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the acquiring bank or payment processor that processed the original transaction and is handling the chargeback.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.chargeback.network_code.name: network_code
lpp.chargeback.network_code.description: Card network or payment scheme over which the disputed transaction was processed.

lpp.chargeback.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.chargeback.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary of the organization associated with the chargeback.

lpp.chargeback.location_code.name: location_code
lpp.chargeback.location_code.description: Code identifying the warehouse or fulfillment location associated with the disputed order, nullable when no location can be attributed.

lpp.chargeback.reason_code.name: reason_code
lpp.chargeback.reason_code.description: Card-network-assigned reason code that specifies the technical basis for the chargeback dispute.
value_aliases: 10.4 -> Visa: Other Fraud – Card Absent Environment
13.3 -> Visa: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise
4855 -> Mastercard: Goods or Services Not Provided

lpp.chargeback.reason_category.name: reason_category
lpp.chargeback.reason_category.description: High-level business category grouping the chargeback reason, such as fraud, non-receipt, or duplicate charge.

lpp.chargeback.initiated_date.name: initiated_date
lpp.chargeback.initiated_date.description: Calendar date on which the chargeback dispute was formally initiated by the cardholder or issuing bank.

lpp.chargeback.resolved_date.name: resolved_date
lpp.chargeback.resolved_date.description: Calendar date on which the chargeback dispute was closed or resolved with a final outcome.

lpp.chargeback.amount.name: amount
lpp.chargeback.amount.description: Monetary value of the chargeback dispute in the associated transaction currency.

lpp.chargeback.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.chargeback.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code denoting the currency in which the chargeback amount is expressed.

lpp.chargeback.status.name: status
lpp.chargeback.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the chargeback, indicating whether it is in progress, has been contested, or has reached a final win/loss outcome.

lpp.chargeback.representment_attempted.name: representment_attempted
lpp.chargeback.representment_attempted.description: Flag indicating whether the merchant submitted a representment rebuttal to contest the chargeback.

lpp.chargeback.representment_evidence_ur.name: representment_evidence_uri
lpp.chargeback.representment_evidence_ur.description: Storage URI pointing to the PDF evidence package submitted by the merchant during chargeback representment.

lpp.chargeback.classification.name: classification
lpp.chargeback.classification.description: Internal classification of the chargeback root cause, distinguishing between genuine fraud, friendly fraud, and merchant processing errors.

lpp.company.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.company.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each company record.

lpp.company.code.name: code
lpp.company.code.description: Short internal code used to identify a legal entity within the corporate group, e.g. GR_AU for the Australian subsidiary.

lpp.company.name.name: name
lpp.company.name.description: Full legal name of the company entity, such as 'GlobalRetail Australia Pty Ltd' or 'GlobalRetail France SAS'.

lpp.company.country.name: country
lpp.company.country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code indicating the country of incorporation or primary operation for the entity, e.g. AU for Australia.

lpp.company.consolidation_code.name: consolidation_code
lpp.company.consolidation_code.description: Internal code used to group or identify this entity within the financial consolidation reporting structure.

lpp.company.corp_id_code.name: corp_id_code
lpp.company.corp_id_code.description: Corporate identity code assigned to the entity, typically used for cross-system or regulatory identification purposes.

lpp.company.lei.name: lei
lpp.company.lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) assigned to the company for use in financial transactions and regulatory reporting, e.g. LEI-GRAU for the Australian entity.

lpp.company.other_identifier_type.name: other_identifier_type
lpp.company.other_identifier_type.description: Numeric code indicating the type of an additional regulatory or business identifier held for the entity beyond the LEI.

lpp.company.other_identifier_value.name: other_identifier_value
lpp.company.other_identifier_value.description: The actual value of the supplementary identifier whose type is specified in other_identifier_type.

lpp.company.sepa_creditor_identifier.name: sepa_creditor_identifier
lpp.company.sepa_creditor_identifier.description: SEPA Creditor Identifier assigned to the company, enabling it to initiate direct debit mandates within the SEPA payment scheme.

lpp.company.txp.name: txp
lpp.company.txp.description: Tax payment or taxpayer profile code associated with the entity for use in payment or remittance instructions.

lpp.company.tax_ids.name: tax_ids
lpp.company.tax_ids.description: Structured collection of tax identification numbers (e.g. VAT, EIN, ABN) registered for the entity across jurisdictions.

lpp.company.address.name: address
lpp.company.address.description: Structured registered or business address details for the company entity.

lpp.company.contact.name: contact
lpp.company.contact.description: Structured contact information for the company entity, such as phone numbers and email addresses.

lpp.company.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.company.user_zones.description: Structured definition of access zones or user groups that are permitted to interact with this company entity in the platform.

lpp.company.parent_company_ref.name: parent_company_ref
lpp.company.parent_company_ref.description: Internal company code of the immediate parent entity in the corporate hierarchy, such as GR_HOLDINGS or GR_EU_BV.

lpp.company.ownership_pct.name: ownership_pct
lpp.company.ownership_pct.description: Percentage of the entity's equity owned by its parent company, used in consolidation calculations.

lpp.company.consolidation_method.name: consolidation_method
lpp.company.consolidation_method.description: Accounting method applied when consolidating the entity's financials into the group, either full consolidation or as a parent-only entity.

lpp.company.entity_role.name: entity_role
lpp.company.entity_role.description: Functional role of the company within the corporate group structure, such as operating company, sub-holding, ultimate parent, or treasury entity.

lpp.company_financial_metric.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.company_financial_metric.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or business unit within the group (e.g., GR_HOLDINGS, GR_US_INC, GR_TREASURY).

lpp.company_financial_metric.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.company_financial_metric.period_date.description: The closing date of the reporting period for which the financial metrics apply, aligned to quarter-end or year-end boundaries (e.g., 2023-06-30, 2023-09-30).

lpp.company_financial_metric.period_type.name: period_type
lpp.company_financial_metric.period_type.description: Indicates whether the reported figures cover a single quarter, a full fiscal year, or a trailing twelve-month window.

lpp.company_financial_metric.reporting_c.name: reporting_currency
lpp.company_financial_metric.reporting_c.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary metrics for the row are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.company_financial_metric.revenue.name: revenue
lpp.company_financial_metric.revenue.description: Total net revenue (top-line sales) recognised by the entity during the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.cogs.name: cogs
lpp.company_financial_metric.cogs.description: Cost of goods sold representing the direct costs attributable to the production of goods or services sold during the period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.ebitda.name: ebitda
lpp.company_financial_metric.ebitda.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation, used as a proxy for operating cash profitability.

lpp.company_financial_metric.operating_i.name: operating_income
lpp.company_financial_metric.operating_i.description: Profit generated from core business operations after deducting operating expenses including depreciation and amortisation but before interest and tax.

lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_in.name: interest_income
lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_in.description: Income earned from interest-bearing assets such as cash deposits and short-term investments during the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_ex.name: interest_expense
lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_ex.description: Cost incurred on outstanding debt and borrowings in the form of interest payments during the reporting period.

lpp.company_financial_metric.net_income.name: net_income
lpp.company_financial_metric.net_income.description: Bottom-line profit remaining after all expenses, interest, taxes, and other charges have been deducted from revenue.

lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_eps.name: diluted_eps
lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_eps.description: Earnings per share calculated on a fully diluted basis, accounting for all potentially dilutive securities.

lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_from_o.name: cash_from_operations
lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_from_o.description: Net cash generated from the entity's core operating activities as reported in the cash flow statement.

lpp.company_financial_metric.capex.name: capex
lpp.company_financial_metric.capex.description: Capital expenditure representing cash spent on acquiring or upgrading long-term physical or intangible assets.

lpp.company_financial_metric.free_cash_f.name: free_cash_flow
lpp.company_financial_metric.free_cash_f.description: Cash generated from operations after deducting capital expenditure, representing cash available to investors and creditors.

lpp.company_financial_metric.total_debt.name: total_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.total_debt.description: Aggregate of all interest-bearing debt obligations, both short-term and long-term, outstanding at the period end.

lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.name: short_term_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.description: Portion of interest-bearing debt obligations due within twelve months of the period end date.

lpp.company_financial_metric.long_term_d.name: long_term_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.long_term_d.description: Debt obligations with a maturity of more than twelve months from the period end date.

lpp.company_financial_metric.total_equit.name: total_equity
lpp.company_financial_metric.total_equit.description: Total shareholders' equity representing the residual interest in the entity's assets after deducting all liabilities.

lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_and_eq.name: cash_and_equivalents
lpp.company_financial_metric.cash_and_eq.description: Highly liquid cash and near-cash balances held by the entity at the period end date.

lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.name: short_term_investments
lpp.company_financial_metric.short_term_.description: Investments with maturities of less than twelve months held as part of the entity's liquidity management strategy.

lpp.company_financial_metric.net_debt.name: net_debt
lpp.company_financial_metric.net_debt.description: Total debt reduced by cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments, reflecting the entity's true financial indebtedness.

lpp.company_financial_metric.debt_to_ebi.name: debt_to_ebitda
lpp.company_financial_metric.debt_to_ebi.description: Ratio of total debt to EBITDA measuring how many years of operating earnings would be required to repay the debt.

lpp.company_financial_metric.leverage_ra.name: leverage_ratio
lpp.company_financial_metric.leverage_ra.description: A measure of the entity's financial leverage, typically calculated as total debt relative to equity or total assets.

lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_co.name: interest_coverage
lpp.company_financial_metric.interest_co.description: Ratio indicating how many times the entity's operating earnings can cover its interest expense obligations.

lpp.company_financial_metric.wacc_pct.name: wacc_pct
lpp.company_financial_metric.wacc_pct.description: Weighted average cost of capital expressed as a percentage, representing the blended required rate of return across all capital sources.

lpp.company_financial_metric.weighted_av.name: weighted_avg_cost_of_debt_pct
lpp.company_financial_metric.weighted_av.description: The blended average interest rate paid across all outstanding debt instruments, expressed as a percentage.

lpp.company_financial_metric.return_on_c.name: return_on_capital_pct
lpp.company_financial_metric.return_on_c.description: Percentage return generated on total capital employed, measuring how efficiently the entity uses its capital base.

lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_sha.name: diluted_shares_outstanding
lpp.company_financial_metric.diluted_sha.description: Total number of shares outstanding on a fully diluted basis, including the effect of all convertible instruments and options.

lpp.company_financial_metric.fy_ebitda_g.name: fy_ebitda_guidance_low
lpp.company_financial_metric.fy_ebitda_g.description: Lower bound of management's publicly issued full-year EBITDA guidance range for the fiscal year.

lpp.company_financial_metric.fy_ebitda_g.name: fy_ebitda_guidance_high
lpp.company_financial_metric.fy_ebitda_g.description: Upper bound of management's publicly issued full-year EBITDA guidance range for the fiscal year.

lpp.company_group.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.company_group.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each company group record.

lpp.company_group.code.name: code
lpp.company_group.code.description: Short alphanumeric code representing a defined organizational or regional company grouping, such as global consolidation or a geographic region like AMER, EMEA, or APAC.

lpp.company_group.description.name: description
lpp.company_group.description.description: Human-readable label explaining the business scope or geographic coverage of the company group, such as 'Americas' or 'Store-operating companies only'.

lpp.company_group_member.company_group_c.name: company_group_code
lpp.company_group_member.company_group_c.description: Identifies the regional or functional company group to which a member belongs, such as global, Americas, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, or retail operating company.

lpp.company_group_member.company_code.name: company_code
lpp.company_group_member.company_code.description: Identifies an individual legal entity or subsidiary within a company group, typically denoting the country or functional unit of incorporation (e.g., GR_US_INC for US entity, GR_DE for Germany).

lpp.counterparty_exposure.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.counterparty_exposure.as_of_date.description: The reporting date as of which the counterparty exposure snapshot was captured.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.counterparty_b.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.counterparty_exposure.counterparty_b.description: Internal reference code identifying the counterparty bank with which the exposure is held (e.g., BANK_BNP for BNP Paribas, BANK_JPM for JPMorgan).

lpp.counterparty_exposure.deposits_amoun.name: deposits_amount
lpp.counterparty_exposure.deposits_amoun.description: The monetary value of cash deposits placed with the counterparty bank as of the reporting date.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.investments_am.name: investments_amount
lpp.counterparty_exposure.investments_am.description: The monetary value of investment securities or instruments held with the counterparty bank as of the reporting date.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.derivative_mtm.name: derivative_mtm_amount
lpp.counterparty_exposure.derivative_mtm.description: The mark-to-market value of derivative contracts outstanding with the counterparty bank as of the reporting date.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.total_exposure.name: total_exposure
lpp.counterparty_exposure.total_exposure.description: The aggregate monetary exposure to the counterparty bank, encompassing deposits, investments, and derivative mark-to-market values.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.reporting_curr.name: reporting_currency
lpp.counterparty_exposure.reporting_curr.description: The currency in which all monetary exposure amounts are reported, consistently USD across all records.

lpp.counterparty_exposure.pct_of_total.name: pct_of_total
lpp.counterparty_exposure.pct_of_total.description: The percentage share of this counterparty's total exposure relative to the overall portfolio counterparty exposure as of the reporting date.

lpp.credit_facility.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.credit_facility.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credit facility record.

lpp.credit_facility.code.name: code
lpp.credit_facility.code.description: Business code that encodes the facility type, currency, and borrowing entity (e.g., CF_RCF_USD_2B for a USD 2-billion revolving credit facility, CF_IC_GR_AE for an intercompany facility for the UAE entity).

lpp.credit_facility.facility_type.name: facility_type
lpp.credit_facility.facility_type.description: Classification of the credit facility indicating the structure of the lending arrangement, such as revolving credit, term loan, overdraft, commercial paper, or intercompany.

lpp.credit_facility.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.credit_facility.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that is the borrower or beneficiary of the credit facility.

lpp.credit_facility.lender_bank_ref.name: lender_bank_ref
lpp.credit_facility.lender_bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank or financial institution providing the credit facility.

lpp.credit_facility.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.credit_facility.currency_ref.description: ISO currency code indicating the denomination in which the credit facility is drawn and repaid.

lpp.credit_facility.commitment_amount.name: commitment_amount
lpp.credit_facility.commitment_amount.description: Total maximum amount committed by the lender under the credit facility, expressed in the facility's currency.

lpp.credit_facility.start_date.name: start_date
lpp.credit_facility.start_date.description: The date on which the credit facility became effective and available for drawdown.

lpp.credit_facility.maturity_date.name: maturity_date
lpp.credit_facility.maturity_date.description: The date on which the credit facility expires and all outstanding amounts must be repaid.

lpp.credit_facility.benchmark_code.name: benchmark_code
lpp.credit_facility.benchmark_code.description: The interest rate benchmark index used as the base rate for pricing the facility, such as SOFR (USD), ESTR (EUR), or SONIA (GBP).

lpp.credit_facility.spread_bps.name: spread_bps
lpp.credit_facility.spread_bps.description: The credit spread charged above the benchmark rate, expressed in basis points, representing the lender's margin on the facility.

lpp.credit_facility.commitment_fee_bps.name: commitment_fee_bps
lpp.credit_facility.commitment_fee_bps.description: The annual fee charged in basis points on the undrawn portion of the credit facility, applicable primarily to revolving and term facilities.

lpp.credit_facility.status.name: status
lpp.credit_facility.status.description: Current operational status of the credit facility, indicating whether it is active and available for use.

lpp.credit_rating.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.credit_rating.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credit rating record.

lpp.credit_rating.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.credit_rating.company_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary to which the credit rating applies, such as GR_HOLDINGS or GR_US_INC.

lpp.credit_rating.agency.name: agency
lpp.credit_rating.agency.description: The credit rating agency that issued the rating, such as Moody's, S&P, or Fitch.

lpp.credit_rating.rating_grade.name: rating_grade
lpp.credit_rating.rating_grade.description: The alphanumeric credit rating grade assigned by the agency, representing the creditworthiness of the entity (e.g., A1, A+, AA-, BBB+).

lpp.credit_rating.outlook.name: outlook
lpp.credit_rating.outlook.description: The agency's forward-looking assessment of the likely direction of the credit rating, such as Stable or Positive.

lpp.credit_rating.rating_action.name: rating_action
lpp.credit_rating.rating_action.description: The most recent action taken by the rating agency on the credit rating, such as an affirmation or upgrade.

lpp.credit_rating.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.credit_rating.as_of_date.description: The effective date on which the credit rating was assigned or last updated by the agency.

lpp.credit_rating.is_current.name: is_current
lpp.credit_rating.is_current.description: Flag indicating whether this rating record represents the most current active rating for the entity and agency combination.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each individual cross-border payment leg record.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.transfer_uu.name: transfer_uuid
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.transfer_uu.description: Unique identifier of the parent transfer that this payment leg belongs to.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_tra.name: payment_transaction_uuid
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_tra.description: Unique identifier of the underlying payment transaction associated with this leg.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.origination.name: origination_country
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.origination.description: ISO country code of the country from which the cross-border payment originates (e.g., SE for Sweden, BR for Brazil, GB for United Kingdom).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.destination.name: destination_country
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.destination.description: ISO country code of the country where the cross-border payment is being sent to (e.g., GB for United Kingdom, JP for Japan, IN for India).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_curren.name: send_currency
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_curren.description: ISO currency code of the currency in which the payment is sent by the originating party (e.g., EUR, USD, GBP).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_cur.name: receive_currency
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_cur.description: ISO currency code of the currency in which the beneficiary receives the payment (e.g., GBP, JPY, INR).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corridor.name: corridor
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corridor.description: Named geographic corridor representing the origin-to-destination region pairing for the cross-border payment (e.g., US-EU, EU-APAC, US-MX).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_amount.name: send_amount
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.send_amount.description: The monetary amount sent by the originating party in the send currency.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_amo.name: receive_amount
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.receive_amo.description: The monetary amount received by the beneficiary in the receive currency after conversion.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_rate_app.name: fx_rate_applied
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_rate_app.description: The foreign exchange conversion rate applied to this payment leg when converting from send currency to receive currency.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_spread_b.name: fx_spread_bps
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.fx_spread_b.description: The foreign exchange spread charged on this payment leg, expressed in basis points (e.g., 41 bps, 75 bps).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.lifting_fee.name: lifting_fees
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.lifting_fee.description: Fees charged by the sending or intermediary bank to process and lift the cross-border payment.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corresponde.name: correspondent_fees
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.corresponde.description: Fees charged by correspondent banks involved in routing or settling the cross-border payment.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_met.name: payment_method
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.payment_met.description: The payment rail or method used to execute this cross-border payment leg (e.g., SEPA_CT, WIRE, RTP, ACH).

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.initiated_a.name: initiated_at
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.initiated_a.description: Timestamp indicating when the cross-border payment leg was initiated.

lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.delivered_a.name: delivered_at
lpp.cross_border_payment_leg.delivered_a.description: Timestamp indicating when the cross-border payment leg was successfully delivered to the beneficiary.

lpp.currency.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.currency.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each currency record.

lpp.currency.code.name: code
lpp.currency.code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter alphabetic code representing the currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.currency.description.name: description
lpp.currency.description.description: Full human-readable name of the currency (e.g., 'US Dollar', 'Euro', 'Pound Sterling').

lpp.currency.number_of_decimals.name: number_of_decimals
lpp.currency.number_of_decimals.description: The number of decimal places used when expressing monetary amounts in this currency.

lpp.currency.delivery_float.name: delivery_float
lpp.currency.delivery_float.description: The number of business days allowed for settlement or delivery of transactions in this currency.

lpp.currency.is_reference.name: is_reference
lpp.currency.is_reference.description: Flag indicating whether this currency serves as the reference or base currency for exchange rate calculations.

lpp.currency.hide_in_list.name: hide_in_list
lpp.currency.hide_in_list.description: Flag indicating whether this currency should be hidden from user-facing currency selection lists or dropdowns.

lpp.data_permission.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.data_permission.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each data permission record.

lpp.data_permission.profile_code.name: profile_code
lpp.data_permission.profile_code.description: Coded label representing a named access profile that determines the scope and level of data permissions granted, such as global full access, regional read-write, or functional operations access.

lpp.data_permission.entity_type.name: entity_type
lpp.data_permission.entity_type.description: Classifies the type of business entity to which the data permission applies, either a company legal entity or a bank account.

lpp.data_permission.entity_code.name: entity_code
lpp.data_permission.entity_code.description: Short code identifying the specific company or bank account entity to which the data permission is scoped, such as a country-level subsidiary or a regional treasury account.

lpp.data_permission_profile.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.data_permission_profile.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each data permission profile record.

lpp.data_permission_profile.code.name: code
lpp.data_permission_profile.code.description: Short machine-readable code designating a named data permission profile, such as global full access, regional read/write, or functional operations roles.

lpp.data_permission_profile.description.name: description
lpp.data_permission_profile.description.description: Human-readable explanation of the data permission profile's scope and access level, such as regional read/write or cross-entity audit access.

lpp.derivative_mtm.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.derivative_mtm.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each mark-to-market record for system-level deduplication and traceability.

lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_type.name: instrument_type
lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_type.description: Category of the derivative financial instrument being valued, with all current records representing FX forward contracts.

lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_ref.description: Unique business reference code identifying a specific derivative instrument, such as an individual FX forward deal.

lpp.derivative_mtm.counterparty_bank_ref.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.counterparty_bank_ref.description: Code identifying the external bank acting as the counterparty to the derivative transaction.

lpp.derivative_mtm.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.company_ref.description: Code identifying the internal legal entity or group company that is a party to the derivative contract.

lpp.derivative_mtm.valuation_date.name: valuation_date
lpp.derivative_mtm.valuation_date.description: The date on which the mark-to-market value of the derivative instrument was calculated.

lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_amount.name: mtm_amount
lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_amount.description: The mark-to-market fair value of the derivative instrument on the valuation date, expressed in the MTM currency.

lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_currency.name: mtm_currency
lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_currency.description: The currency in which the mark-to-market amount is denominated, with all current records expressed in US dollars.

lpp.equity_action.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.equity_action.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each equity action record.

lpp.equity_action.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.equity_action.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the company associated with the equity action (e.g., GR_HOLDINGS).

lpp.equity_action.action_type.name: action_type
lpp.equity_action.action_type.description: Category of equity action taken by the company, such as a share buyback, regular dividend, or special dividend.

lpp.equity_action.action_date.name: action_date
lpp.equity_action.action_date.description: The date on which the equity action (e.g., dividend declaration or buyback execution) occurred.

lpp.equity_action.settle_date.name: settle_date
lpp.equity_action.settle_date.description: The date on which the equity action was financially settled or the payment was completed.

lpp.equity_action.shares.name: shares
lpp.equity_action.shares.description: Number of shares involved in the equity action, such as shares repurchased in a buyback or shares receiving a dividend.

lpp.equity_action.price_per_share.name: price_per_share
lpp.equity_action.price_per_share.description: The price paid per share in the equity action, applicable primarily to buyback transactions.

lpp.equity_action.total_amount.name: total_amount
lpp.equity_action.total_amount.description: Total monetary value of the equity action, representing the aggregate cash outlay for the buyback or dividend payment.

lpp.equity_action.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.equity_action.currency_code.description: ISO currency code in which the equity action amounts are denominated (e.g., USD).

lpp.equity_action.dividend_per_share.name: dividend_per_share
lpp.equity_action.dividend_per_share.description: The dividend amount distributed per share, applicable to dividend-type equity actions.

lpp.equity_action.program_name.name: program_name
lpp.equity_action.program_name.description: Name of the specific corporate program under which the equity action was executed, such as a named buyback or dividend program.

lpp.equity_action.authorization_remainin.name: authorization_remaining
lpp.equity_action.authorization_remainin.description: Remaining monetary authorization available under a buyback or similar equity program after the current action is executed.

lpp.fee_rate_card.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fee_rate_card.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each fee rate card record.

lpp.fee_rate_card.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.fee_rate_card.bank_ref.description: Coded reference identifying the bank or financial institution to which the fee rate applies (e.g., BANK_ANZ for ANZ, BANK_JPM for JPMorgan).

lpp.fee_rate_card.service_code.name: service_code
lpp.fee_rate_card.service_code.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific banking service or product to which the negotiated fee rate applies.

lpp.fee_rate_card.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fee_rate_card.company_ref.description: Reference identifier for the internal company or legal entity associated with the fee rate card.

lpp.fee_rate_card.negotiated_rate.name: negotiated_rate
lpp.fee_rate_card.negotiated_rate.description: The contractually agreed fee rate charged for the associated service, expressed in the units defined by rate_unit.

lpp.fee_rate_card.rate_unit.name: rate_unit
lpp.fee_rate_card.rate_unit.description: Defines the billing basis for the negotiated rate, indicating whether the fee is charged per transaction, per month, or per USD 1,000.

lpp.fee_rate_card.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.fee_rate_card.currency_code.description: ISO currency code indicating the denomination in which the negotiated rate is expressed (currently USD only).

lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_from.description: The date from which the fee rate card becomes contractually effective and applicable for billing.

lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_to.description: The date on which the fee rate card expires and is no longer applicable; a null value indicates the rate is currently active with no set end date.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each forecast cash flow record.
