lpp.forecast_cash_flow.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.snapshot_id.description: Identifier for the forecast snapshot version, encoding the snapshot date and frequency (e.g. monthly 'M' or quarterly 'Q') at which the forecast was produced.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary for which the cash flow is forecast, such as a regional operating company or treasury entity.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.account_ref.description: Reference to the bank or ledger account associated with the forecast cash flow.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_date.name: forecast_date
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_date.description: The calendar date (month-start) for which the cash flow amount is forecast to occur.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_category.name: flow_category
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_category.description: High-level classification of the cash flow type, such as accounts payable disbursements, accounts receivable collections, payroll, tax, capital expenditure, intercompany transfers, or debt service.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_subcategory.name: flow_subcategory
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_subcategory.description: Further granular classification of the cash flow within its parent category.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.direction.name: direction
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.direction.description: Indicates whether the forecast cash flow is an outflow, inflow, or encompasses both directions.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_amount.name: forecast_amount
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_amount.description: The projected monetary value of the cash flow for the forecast period, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the forecast amount is denominated, such as USD, GBP, or JPY.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.confidence.name: confidence
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.confidence.description: Qualitative rating indicating the degree of certainty in the forecast amount, ranging from LOW to HIGH.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.seasonality_facto.name: seasonality_factor
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.seasonality_facto.description: Multiplicative adjustment factor applied to account for seasonal patterns in cash flow, where 1.0 represents no seasonal adjustment, values below 1.0 indicate a seasonal trough, and values above 1.0 indicate a seasonal peak.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for a forecast snapshot, encoding the forecast date and granularity (e.g., 'FC_20240501_M' for a monthly snapshot taken in May 2024).

lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_date.name: snapshot_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_date.description: The calendar date on which the forecast snapshot was created or published.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_start_date.name: horizon_start_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_start_date.description: The first date of the forecast horizon covered by this snapshot.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_end_date.name: horizon_end_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_end_date.description: The last date of the forecast horizon covered by this snapshot.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.granularity.name: granularity
lpp.forecast_snapshot.granularity.description: The time granularity at which forecast data is bucketed within this snapshot, either daily or monthly.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.model_version.name: model_version
lpp.forecast_snapshot.model_version.description: The version identifier of the forecasting model used to generate this snapshot (e.g., 'v1.3').

lpp.forecast_snapshot.description.name: description
lpp.forecast_snapshot.description.description: A human-readable label describing the forecast type and horizon, such as 'Monthly 13-week direct forecast' or 'Quarterly 18-month indirect forecast'.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.company_ref.description: Unique code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the corporate group (e.g., GR_AE for the UAE entity, GR_US_INC for the US entity).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.period_date.description: The last calendar day of the reporting month for which forecast and actual cash flow amounts are compared.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.flow_category.name: flow_category
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.flow_category.description: Classification of the cash flow type being tracked, such as capital expenditure, tax payments, payroll, accounts receivable collections, accounts payable disbursements, or FX revaluation.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.forecast_amount.name: forecast_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.forecast_amount.description: The projected cash flow amount in the reporting currency for the given entity, period, and flow category as captured in the forecast snapshot.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.actual_amount.name: actual_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.actual_amount.description: The realised cash flow amount in the reporting currency for the given entity, period, and flow category as recorded in the books.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_amount.name: variance_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_amount.description: The absolute monetary difference between the actual and forecast cash flow amounts, indicating over- or under-performance against the plan.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_pct.name: variance_pct
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_pct.description: The percentage difference between the actual and forecast cash flow amounts, expressing the relative magnitude of forecast error (e.g., -7.0000 means actuals were 7% below forecast).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for the forecast run or version, encoding the snapshot date and cadence (e.g., FC_20230501_M represents the monthly forecast produced in May 2023).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in the record are denominated, currently standardised to USD across all entities.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each fraud detection event record.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.transfer_uuid.name: transfer_uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.transfer_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the payment transfer associated with this fraud detection event, when the event relates to a transfer.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.file_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the file associated with this fraud detection event, when the event relates to a file submission.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.decision.name: decision
lpp.fraud_detection_event.decision.description: The outcome of the fraud evaluation, indicating whether the transaction or file was allowed to proceed, flagged for manual review, or blocked.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.score.name: score
lpp.fraud_detection_event.score.description: Numeric fraud risk score assigned by the fraud detection engine, where higher values indicate greater likelihood of fraudulent activity.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.reason_codes.name: reason_codes
lpp.fraud_detection_event.reason_codes.description: Structured list of reason codes explaining the factors that contributed to the fraud detection decision.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.raised_at.name: raised_at
lpp.fraud_detection_event.raised_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the fraud detection event was generated and the decision was issued.

lpp.fraud_loss.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fraud_loss.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each fraud loss record.

lpp.fraud_loss.detection_event_uuid.name: detection_event_uuid
lpp.fraud_loss.detection_event_uuid.description: Unique identifier referencing the fraud detection event that triggered this loss record.

lpp.fraud_loss.authorization_ref.name: authorization_ref
lpp.fraud_loss.authorization_ref.description: Unique reference identifier for the payment authorization associated with the fraudulent transaction.

lpp.fraud_loss.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fraud_loss.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or country-specific subsidiary where the fraud loss was incurred (e.g., GR_US_INC, GR_CA, GR_GB).

lpp.fraud_loss.channel.name: channel
lpp.fraud_loss.channel.description: Sales or service channel through which the fraudulent transaction occurred, such as in-warehouse, e-commerce, or membership renewal.

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_date.name: loss_date
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_date.description: Calendar date on which the fraud loss was recorded or incurred.

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_amount.name: loss_amount
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_amount.description: Monetary value of the fraud loss incurred for the transaction, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.fraud_loss.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.fraud_loss.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the loss amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_category.name: loss_category
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_category.description: Classification of the fraud loss indicating whether it was committed by an external bad actor (true fraud) or disputed by the cardholder themselves (friendly fraud).

lpp.fraud_loss.fraud_vector.name: fraud_vector
lpp.fraud_loss.fraud_vector.description: The method or attack vector through which the fraud was executed, such as card-not-present transactions or social engineering.

lpp.fraud_loss.issuer_country.name: issuer_country
lpp.fraud_loss.issuer_country.description: Country code of the financial institution that issued the payment card used in the fraudulent transaction.

lpp.fraud_loss.auth_method.name: auth_method
lpp.fraud_loss.auth_method.description: Authentication method applied at the time of the transaction, indicating whether 3D Secure was used and whether a challenge was presented.

lpp.fraud_loss.recovered_amount.name: recovered_amount
lpp.fraud_loss.recovered_amount.description: Monetary amount recovered after the fraud loss was identified, such as through chargebacks or collections.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each FX exposure forecast record.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group that carries the FX exposure (e.g., GR_HOLDINGS, GR_US_INC).

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.forecast_period.name: forecast_period
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.forecast_period.description: Month-end date representing the future period to which the forecasted FX exposure applies.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.tenor_bucket.name: tenor_bucket
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.tenor_bucket.description: Time-to-maturity bucket classifying how far in the future the exposure falls, grouped as 0–1 month, 1–3 months, or 3–6 months.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.exposure_curren.name: exposure_currency
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.exposure_curren.description: ISO currency code of the foreign currency in which the exposure is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY).

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.functional_curr.name: functional_currency
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.functional_curr.description: ISO currency code of the reporting or functional currency of the entity against which the FX exposure is measured (e.g., GBP, EUR).

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.gross_exposure_.name: gross_exposure_amount
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.gross_exposure_.description: Total gross monetary value of the FX exposure for the period, expressed in the exposure currency before any netting or hedging.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.direction.name: direction
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.direction.description: Indicates whether the entity has a long (receivable/asset) or short (payable/liability) position in the exposure currency.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.source.name: source
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.source.description: Business origin or category of the FX exposure, such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, intercompany loans, or forecasted purchases and sales.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.snapshot_date.name: snapshot_date
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.snapshot_date.description: Month-end date on which the FX exposure forecast data was captured or extracted, representing the point-in-time view of the forecast.

lpp.fx_forward.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fx_forward.uuid.description: Universally unique system-generated identifier for each FX forward record.

lpp.fx_forward.deal_id.name: deal_id
lpp.fx_forward.deal_id.description: Business-facing reference code assigned to each FX forward deal, formatted as FXF-XXXXXXX.

lpp.fx_forward.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fx_forward.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary of the group that entered into the FX forward contract.

lpp.fx_forward.counterparty_bank_ref.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.fx_forward.counterparty_bank_ref.description: Code identifying the external bank acting as counterparty to the FX forward transaction.

lpp.fx_forward.trade_date.name: trade_date
lpp.fx_forward.trade_date.description: The calendar date on which the FX forward contract was agreed and executed.

lpp.fx_forward.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.fx_forward.value_date.description: The future settlement date on which the currency exchange under the forward contract is due to occur.

lpp.fx_forward.buy_currency.name: buy_currency
lpp.fx_forward.buy_currency.description: The ISO currency code of the currency the company is purchasing under the FX forward contract.

lpp.fx_forward.buy_amount.name: buy_amount
lpp.fx_forward.buy_amount.description: The notional amount of the buy currency to be received on the forward contract settlement date.

lpp.fx_forward.sell_currency.name: sell_currency
lpp.fx_forward.sell_currency.description: The ISO currency code of the currency the company is selling under the FX forward contract, consistently USD in this dataset.

lpp.fx_forward.sell_amount.name: sell_amount
lpp.fx_forward.sell_amount.description: The notional amount of the sell currency to be delivered on the forward contract settlement date.

lpp.fx_forward.forward_rate.name: forward_rate
lpp.fx_forward.forward_rate.description: The agreed contractual exchange rate at which the currency pair will be exchanged on the value date.

lpp.fx_forward.spot_at_trade.name: spot_at_trade
lpp.fx_forward.spot_at_trade.description: The prevailing spot exchange rate for the currency pair recorded at the time the forward contract was traded.

lpp.fx_forward.status.name: status
lpp.fx_forward.status.description: The current lifecycle state of the FX forward contract, indicating whether it is open, has been settled, or was cancelled.

lpp.fx_rate.rate_date.name: rate_date
lpp.fx_rate.rate_date.description: The calendar date on which the foreign exchange rate is effective or was observed.

lpp.fx_rate.base_currency.name: base_currency
lpp.fx_rate.base_currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the base (from) currency in the exchange rate pair, such as USD, EUR, or BRL.

lpp.fx_rate.quote_currency.name: quote_currency
lpp.fx_rate.quote_currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the quote (to) currency in the exchange rate pair, representing the currency in which the base currency is priced.

lpp.fx_rate.rate.name: rate
lpp.fx_rate.rate.description: The numeric exchange rate expressing how many units of the quote currency are equivalent to one unit of the base currency.

lpp.fx_rate.rate_type.name: rate_type
lpp.fx_rate.rate_type.description: The type of exchange rate observation, indicating whether the rate is a real-time spot rate, a daily closing rate, or a periodic average rate.

lpp.fx_rate.source.name: source
lpp.fx_rate.source.description: The data provider or origin from which the exchange rate was obtained, such as Bloomberg, the European Central Bank, or an internal system.

lpp.fx_rate.as_of_timestamp.name: as_of_timestamp
lpp.fx_rate.as_of_timestamp.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the exchange rate record was last updated or loaded into the system.

lpp.gen_company_region.company_code.name: company_code
lpp.gen_company_region.company_code.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying a legal entity within the group, typically combining a 'GR_' prefix with a country or regional abbreviation (e.g., GR_AU for Australia, GR_FR for France).

lpp.gen_company_region.region.name: region
lpp.gen_company_region.region.description: Geographic business region to which the company belongs, such as EMEA, APAC, AMER, LATAM, or MENA.

lpp.gen_company_region.functional_ccy.name: functional_ccy
lpp.gen_company_region.functional_ccy.description: ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional (local reporting) currency of the company entity, such as EUR for eurozone entities or AUD for the Australian entity.

lpp.gl_account.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.gl_account.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each general ledger account record.

lpp.gl_account.code.name: code
lpp.gl_account.code.description: Structured alphanumeric code identifying a GL account, encoding the numeric account number, company entity, and account purpose (e.g. '1110-GR_AE_COLLECTION_1').

lpp.gl_account.description.name: description
lpp.gl_account.description.description: Human-readable label explaining the purpose of the GL account, such as 'Cash - GR_AU OPERATING Account' or 'Accounts Receivable'.

lpp.gl_account.chart_of_accounts.name: chart_of_accounts
lpp.gl_account.chart_of_accounts.description: The financial system or ERP platform that owns and manages this GL account, such as SAP, NetSuite, or Oracle.

lpp.gl_account.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.gl_account.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that the GL account belongs to, such as 'GR_AU' for the Australian entity or 'GR_TREASURY' for the treasury entity.

lpp.gl_account.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.gl_account.bank_account_ref.description: Reference code linking a GL account to a specific physical bank account (e.g. 'GR_AU_OPERATING_1'), populated only for cash-type GL accounts.

lpp.gl_account.account_class.name: account_class
lpp.gl_account.account_class.description: High-level classification of the GL account within the balance sheet or income statement, indicating whether it is an asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense account.

lpp.gl_account.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.gl_account.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency in which the GL account is denominated, such as 'USD', 'EUR', or 'AUD'.

lpp.gl_balance.gl_account_ref.name: gl_account_ref
lpp.gl_balance.gl_account_ref.description: A composite reference uniquely identifying a general ledger account by combining an account number code with an entity or legal entity identifier (e.g., '7000-GR_GB', '1200-GR_HOLDINGS').

lpp.gl_balance.balance_date.name: balance_date
lpp.gl_balance.balance_date.description: The month-end date as of which the general ledger balance is reported, always falling on the last calendar day of a given month.

lpp.gl_balance.balance_type.name: balance_type
lpp.gl_balance.balance_type.description: Indicates the type of balance recorded, with all current records representing a closing (end-of-period) balance.

lpp.gl_balance.amount.name: amount
lpp.gl_balance.amount.description: The monetary value of the general ledger account balance as of the reporting date, expressed in the account's recorded currency.

lpp.gl_balance.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.gl_balance.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the account balance amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.gl_balance.source_system.name: source_system
lpp.gl_balance.source_system.description: The name of the ERP or financial system from which the general ledger balance data was sourced (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite).

lpp.gl_balance.loaded_at.name: loaded_at
lpp.gl_balance.loaded_at.description: The timestamp at which the balance record was loaded into the data warehouse, typically corresponding to the month-end balance date.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.gl_reconciliation.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each GL reconciliation record.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_account_ref.description: Standardized reference code identifying the bank account being reconciled, encoding region, entity, currency, and account purpose (e.g., operating, payroll, collection, investment).

lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_account_ref.name: gl_account_ref
lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_account_ref.description: General ledger account code combining a chart-of-accounts number prefix with a bank account identifier, used to locate the corresponding balance in the accounting system.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.gl_reconciliation.as_of_date.description: Month-end date as of which the bank and GL balances are compared for reconciliation purposes.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_balance.name: bank_balance
lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_balance.description: The closing balance reported by the bank for the account as of the reconciliation date, expressed in the account's native currency.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_balance.name: gl_balance
lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_balance.description: The closing balance recorded in the general ledger for the corresponding account as of the reconciliation date.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_amount.name: variance_amount
lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_amount.description: The monetary difference between the bank balance and the GL balance at the reconciliation date, with a value of zero indicating a fully matched reconciliation.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_currency.name: variance_currency
lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the variance amount is denominated, reflecting the native currency of the bank account.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.status.name: status
lpp.gl_reconciliation.status.description: Current reconciliation status indicating whether the bank and GL balances have been confirmed as equal or are still under investigation.
value_aliases: MATCHED -> Balances reconciled with no variance
INVESTIGATING -> Variance identified and under review

lpp.gl_reconciliation.notes.name: notes
lpp.gl_reconciliation.notes.description: Free-text commentary entered by reconcilers describing the root cause of a variance or the resolution of a reconciling item.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each hedge de-designation record.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.hedge_ref.name: hedge_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.hedge_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the hedge relationship that has been de-designated, following a HR-XXXXXXX format.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or company within the group for which the hedge de-designation is recorded.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency of the de-designated hedge relationship.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.dedesignation_da.name: dedesignation_date
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.dedesignation_da.description: The date on which the hedge relationship was formally de-designated.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.amount.name: amount
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.amount.description: The notional or fair value amount associated with the de-designated portion of the hedge relationship.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.reason.name: reason
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.reason.description: A short description explaining the business reason why the hedge relationship was de-designated, such as restructuring or termination of the underlying instrument.

lpp.hedge_relationship.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.hedge_relationship.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each hedge relationship record.

lpp.hedge_relationship.code.name: code
lpp.hedge_relationship.code.description: Human-readable business code assigned to uniquely identify a hedge relationship, following the pattern HR-XXXXXXX.

lpp.hedge_relationship.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.hedge_relationship.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group that owns the hedge relationship, such as Treasury, EU, APAC, US, LATAM, or Holdings.

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedge_type.name: hedge_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedge_type.description: Accounting classification of the hedge relationship as defined under hedge accounting standards, indicating whether it is a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or net investment hedge.

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_item_type.name: hedged_item_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_item_type.description: Category of the underlying exposure being hedged, such as recognized accounts payable or receivable, forecasted sales or purchases, or a net investment in a foreign operation.

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_currency.name: hedged_currency
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the foreign currency exposure being hedged within the relationship.

lpp.hedge_relationship.designation_date.name: designation_date
lpp.hedge_relationship.designation_date.description: Calendar date on which the hedge relationship was formally designated and hedge accounting commenced.

lpp.hedge_relationship.dedesignation_dat.name: dedesignation_date
lpp.hedge_relationship.dedesignation_dat.description: Calendar date on which the hedge relationship was dedesignated, ending its hedge accounting treatment; null for relationships that have not been dedesignated.

lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_type.name: instrument_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_type.description: Type of hedging instrument used in the relationship; currently all relationships use FX forward contracts.

lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_ref.description: Business reference code that uniquely identifies the hedging instrument (FX forward contract) designated in the hedge relationship, following the pattern FXF-XXXXXXX.

lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_amount.name: notional_amount
lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_amount.description: The face or notional value of the hedging instrument designated in the hedge relationship, expressed in the notional currency.

lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_currency.name: notional_currency
lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the notional amount of the hedging instrument is denominated.

lpp.hedge_relationship.effectiveness_met.name: effectiveness_method
lpp.hedge_relationship.effectiveness_met.description: Methodology used to assess and measure hedge effectiveness; currently all relationships apply the dollar-offset method.

lpp.hedge_relationship.status.name: status
lpp.hedge_relationship.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the hedge relationship, indicating whether it is active, voluntarily terminated, or dedesignated.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.intercompany_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each intercompany transaction record.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.reference.name: reference
lpp.intercompany_transaction.reference.description: Human-readable business reference number assigned to each intercompany transaction, formatted as IC-XXXXXXX.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.transaction.name: transaction_date
lpp.intercompany_transaction.transaction.description: The calendar date on which the intercompany transaction was recorded or initiated.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.intercompany_transaction.value_date.description: The effective date on which the funds are considered available or the transaction financially settles.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.intercompany_transaction.amount.description: The monetary value transferred in the intercompany transaction, denominated in the associated currency.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.currency_co.name: currency_code
lpp.intercompany_transaction.currency_co.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction amount is denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, JPY).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.purpose.name: purpose
lpp.intercompany_transaction.purpose.description: The business reason or category of the intercompany transaction, such as funding, loan, dividend, royalty, service fee, or cash pooling.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_comp.name: source_company_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_comp.description: The reference code identifying the group entity that originates or sends the intercompany transaction (e.g., the group treasury).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_acco.name: source_account_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_acco.description: The reference code identifying the in-house bank concentration account at the source entity from which funds are sent.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_cash.name: source_cash_flow_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_cash.description: The unique identifier of the cash flow record on the source side that corresponds to this intercompany transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_comp.name: target_company_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_comp.description: The reference code identifying the group subsidiary or legal entity that receives the intercompany transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_acco.name: target_account_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_acco.description: The reference code identifying the collection or receiving account at the target entity where funds are credited.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_cash.name: target_cash_flow_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_cash.description: The unique identifier of the cash flow record on the target side that corresponds to this intercompany transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.status.name: status
lpp.intercompany_transaction.status.description: The current processing status of the intercompany transaction, indicating whether it has been initiated or fully settled.

lpp.interest_accrual.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.interest_accrual.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each interest accrual record.

lpp.interest_accrual.accrual_date.name: accrual_date
lpp.interest_accrual.accrual_date.description: The calendar date on which the interest accrual was recorded.

lpp.interest_accrual.source_type.name: source_type
lpp.interest_accrual.source_type.description: The type of financial instrument or obligation that generated the interest accrual, such as a borrowing, an investment position, or a credit facility fee.

lpp.interest_accrual.source_uuid.name: source_uuid
lpp.interest_accrual.source_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the specific financial instrument or transaction that originated this interest accrual.

lpp.interest_accrual.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.interest_accrual.company_ref.description: Short code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary of the group for which the interest accrual applies.

lpp.interest_accrual.amount.name: amount
lpp.interest_accrual.amount.description: The monetary value of the interest accrued for the given date and source, expressed in the local currency of the record.

lpp.interest_accrual.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.interest_accrual.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the accrual amount is denominated.

lpp.interest_accrual.direction.name: direction
lpp.interest_accrual.direction.description: Indicates whether the interest accrual represents a cost to the company (expense) or a return earned (income).

lpp.investment_instrument.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_instrument.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each investment instrument record.

lpp.investment_instrument.code.name: code
lpp.investment_instrument.code.description: Human-readable business code uniquely identifying each investment instrument, following a structured naming convention such as INV_MMF_0014.

lpp.investment_instrument.instrument_typ.name: instrument_type
lpp.investment_instrument.instrument_typ.description: Category of investment instrument, such as money market fund, time deposit, treasury, certificate of deposit, commercial paper, repo, or bond.

lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_name.name: issuer_name
lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_name.description: Full name of the entity that issued the investment instrument, such as a bank, government, or asset manager (e.g., BlackRock MMF, US Treasury, Bundesrepublik Deutschland).

lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_bank_re.name: issuer_bank_ref
lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_bank_re.description: Code identifying the bank that issued or is associated with the instrument (e.g., BANK_HSBC, BANK_JPM); null for non-bank issuers such as governments.

lpp.investment_instrument.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.investment_instrument.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which the investment instrument is denominated, such as USD, EUR, GBP, or SGD.

lpp.investment_instrument.coupon_rate.name: coupon_rate
lpp.investment_instrument.coupon_rate.description: Annual interest or coupon rate of the investment instrument expressed as a percentage (e.g., 4.10, 5.10); null for instruments that do not pay a coupon.

lpp.investment_instrument.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.investment_instrument.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the investment instrument was originally issued or became effective.

lpp.investment_instrument.maturity_date.name: maturity_date
lpp.investment_instrument.maturity_date.description: Calendar date on which the investment instrument matures and the principal is repaid; null for instruments without a fixed maturity such as open-ended funds.

lpp.investment_instrument.rating.name: rating
lpp.investment_instrument.rating.description: Credit rating assigned to the investment instrument by a rating agency, reflecting its creditworthiness (e.g., AAA, AA+, A-1+).

lpp.investment_position.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_position.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each investment position record.

lpp.investment_position.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.investment_position.instrument_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the financial instrument (e.g. money market fund) held in the position.

lpp.investment_position.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.investment_position.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the company or treasury entity that owns the investment position, currently always the Group Treasury.

lpp.investment_position.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.investment_position.bank_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the investment bank account through which the position is held, segmented by currency (EUR, GBP, USD, SGD).

lpp.investment_position.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.investment_position.as_of_date.description: The valuation date as of which the investment position snapshot was recorded.

lpp.investment_position.face_amount.name: face_amount
lpp.investment_position.face_amount.description: The nominal or par value of the investment position in the position currency.

lpp.investment_position.market_value.name: market_value
lpp.investment_position.market_value.description: The current mark-to-market value of the investment position as of the valuation date.

lpp.investment_position.book_value.name: book_value
lpp.investment_position.book_value.description: The carrying or amortised cost value of the investment position recorded in the books of account.

lpp.investment_position.accrued_interest.name: accrued_interest
lpp.investment_position.accrued_interest.description: The amount of interest that has accumulated on the investment position since the last coupon payment but has not yet been received.

lpp.investment_position.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.investment_position.currency_code.description: The ISO currency code of the investment position, covering EUR, GBP, USD, and SGD.

lpp.investment_position.yield_to_maturit.name: yield_to_maturity
lpp.investment_position.yield_to_maturit.description: The annualised yield to maturity of the investment instrument expressed as a percentage (e.g. 4.1 = 4.10%), partially populated where applicable.

lpp.investment_position.duration_days.name: duration_days
lpp.investment_position.duration_days.description: The duration or remaining term of the investment position expressed in number of days.

lpp.investment_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each investment transaction record.

lpp.investment_transaction.instrument_re.name: instrument_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.instrument_re.description: Reference code identifying the specific investment instrument involved in the transaction, such as a certificate of deposit, term deposit, money market fund, repo, bond, or EZ instrument.

lpp.investment_transaction.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the company or treasury entity that owns or initiated the investment transaction.

lpp.investment_transaction.bank_account_.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.bank_account_.description: Reference code identifying the in-house bank investment account used to settle the transaction, indicating the currency and account type.

lpp.investment_transaction.transaction_t.name: transaction_type
lpp.investment_transaction.transaction_t.description: Classifies the nature of the investment transaction as a purchase, maturity redemption, or coupon payment.

lpp.investment_transaction.trade_date.name: trade_date
lpp.investment_transaction.trade_date.description: The date on which the investment transaction was agreed or executed in the market.

lpp.investment_transaction.settle_date.name: settle_date
lpp.investment_transaction.settle_date.description: The date on which the investment transaction is financially settled and funds are exchanged.

lpp.investment_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.investment_transaction.amount.description: The monetary face value or notional amount of the investment transaction in the transaction currency.

lpp.investment_transaction.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.investment_transaction.currency_code.description: The ISO currency code denoting the currency in which the investment transaction is denominated, such as USD, EUR, GBP, or SGD.

lpp.investment_transaction.price.name: price
lpp.investment_transaction.price.description: The clean or dirty price per unit of the investment instrument at the time of the transaction, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0 for par, 0.9918 for a discount).

lpp.investment_transaction.yield_at_trad.name: yield_at_trade
lpp.investment_transaction.yield_at_trad.description: The annualized yield percentage of the investment instrument at the time the transaction was executed, expressed in percentage points (e.g., 5.10 means 5.10%).

lpp.kg_relationship.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.kg_relationship.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each knowledge graph relationship record.

lpp.kg_relationship.relationship_type.name: relationship_type
lpp.kg_relationship.relationship_type.description: The nature or category of the relationship between two entities in the knowledge graph (e.g., owns, belongs_to, related_to).

lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_type.name: from_entity_type
lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_type.description: The category or class of the source entity in the directed relationship (e.g., person, organization, product).

lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_code.name: from_entity_code
lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_code.description: The unique business code identifying the source entity in the directed relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_type.name: to_entity_type
lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_type.description: The category or class of the target entity in the directed relationship (e.g., person, organization, product).

lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_code.name: to_entity_code
lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_code.description: The unique business code identifying the target entity in the directed relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.properties.name: properties
lpp.kg_relationship.properties.description: A semi-structured collection of additional attributes or metadata describing the relationship in more detail.

lpp.kg_relationship.captured_by_user.name: captured_by_user
lpp.kg_relationship.captured_by_user.description: The username or identifier of the user who recorded this relationship into the knowledge graph.

lpp.kg_relationship.captured_at.name: captured_at
lpp.kg_relationship.captured_at.description: The timestamp at which the relationship was recorded into the knowledge graph.

lpp.kg_relationship.source_session.name: source_session
lpp.kg_relationship.source_session.description: The session or process identifier associated with the data capture event that created this relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.confidence.name: confidence
lpp.kg_relationship.confidence.description: A rating or score indicating the level of certainty or reliability assigned to the relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.status.name: status
lpp.kg_relationship.status.description: The current lifecycle or workflow state of the relationship record (e.g., active, inactive, pending, rejected).

lpp.letter_of_credit.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.letter_of_credit.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each letter of credit record.

lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_number.name: lc_number
lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_number.description: Human-readable reference number assigned to the letter of credit, formatted as LC-{year}-{sequence} (e.g., LC-2024-00021).

lpp.letter_of_credit.issuing_bank_ref.name: issuing_bank_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.issuing_bank_ref.description: Code identifying the bank that issued the letter of credit, such as HSBC, JPMorgan, BNP Paribas, or Citibank.

lpp.letter_of_credit.applicant_company_r.name: applicant_company_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.applicant_company_r.description: Code identifying the internal group entity that applied for the letter of credit, representing subsidiaries across various countries.

lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_name.name: beneficiary_name
lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_name.description: Name of the third-party entity entitled to draw on the letter of credit, such as suppliers, utilities, insurers, or government authorities.

lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_country.name: beneficiary_country
lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_country.description: ISO two-letter country code indicating where the beneficiary of the letter of credit is located.

lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_type.name: lc_type
lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_type.description: Classification of the letter of credit indicating whether it is a standby LC used as a financial guarantee or a commercial LC supporting trade transactions.

lpp.letter_of_credit.purpose.name: purpose
lpp.letter_of_credit.purpose.description: Free-text description of the business reason or obligation the letter of credit is intended to support, such as utility deposits, customs duty deferment, or apparel imports.

lpp.letter_of_credit.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.letter_of_credit.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the letter of credit was officially issued by the bank.

lpp.letter_of_credit.expiration_date.name: expiration_date
lpp.letter_of_credit.expiration_date.description: Calendar date on which the letter of credit expires and can no longer be drawn upon.

lpp.letter_of_credit.face_amount.name: face_amount
lpp.letter_of_credit.face_amount.description: The maximum monetary value guaranteed by the letter of credit in the denominated currency.

lpp.letter_of_credit.drawn_amount.name: drawn_amount
lpp.letter_of_credit.drawn_amount.description: The monetary amount that has actually been drawn or called upon by the beneficiary against the letter of credit.

lpp.letter_of_credit.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.letter_of_credit.currency_code.description: ISO three-letter currency code in which the letter of credit face and drawn amounts are denominated.

lpp.letter_of_credit.status.name: status
lpp.letter_of_credit.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the letter of credit indicating whether it is active, has been drawn upon, or has expired.

lpp.letter_of_credit.credit_facility_ref.name: credit_facility_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.credit_facility_ref.description: Reference code identifying the credit facility under which this letter of credit was issued, such as a revolving credit facility in USD or EUR.

lpp.letter_of_credit.fee_bps.name: fee_bps
lpp.letter_of_credit.fee_bps.description: Annual fee charged by the issuing bank for the letter of credit, expressed in basis points of the face amount.

lpp.liquidity_policy.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.liquidity_policy.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each liquidity policy record.

lpp.liquidity_policy.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.liquidity_policy.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the specific legal entity or company to which the liquidity policy applies.

lpp.liquidity_policy.company_group_ref.name: company_group_ref
lpp.liquidity_policy.company_group_ref.description: Code identifying the regional or global group hierarchy to which the liquidity policy applies, such as global, Americas, EMEA, or APAC.

lpp.liquidity_policy.policy_type.name: policy_type
lpp.liquidity_policy.policy_type.description: Categorical code indicating the type of liquidity policy rule being enforced, such as a minimum liquidity buffer, minimum operating cash, maximum counterparty concentration percentage, or maximum instrument tenor.

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_amount.name: threshold_amount
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_amount.description: Monetary threshold value associated with the liquidity policy, expressed in the currency specified by threshold_currency; applicable to amount-based policy types such as minimum cash floors.

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_currency.name: threshold_currency
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_currency.description: ISO currency code denominating the threshold_amount for the liquidity policy, such as USD or EUR.

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_pct.name: threshold_pct
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_pct.description: Percentage threshold associated with the liquidity policy, used for proportion-based rules such as maximum counterparty concentration limits.

lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_from.description: Date on which the liquidity policy rule becomes active and enforceable.

lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_to.description: Date on which the liquidity policy rule expires and is no longer enforceable; null indicates the policy is currently open-ended.

lpp.liquidity_policy.description.name: description
lpp.liquidity_policy.description.description: Human-readable narrative explaining the purpose or context of the liquidity policy rule, such as regional cash floor definitions or counterparty tier caps.

lpp.macro_indicator.indicator_code.name: indicator_code
lpp.macro_indicator.indicator_code.description: Short code identifying the macroeconomic indicator being tracked, such as the Federal Funds Rate (FED_FUNDS), 3-month SOFR (SOFR_3M), EUR/USD volatility (EUR_USD_VOL), Brent crude oil price (OIL_BRENT), geopolitical risk index (GEOPOL_RISK_INDEX), or US CPI (CPI_US).

lpp.macro_indicator.region.name: region
lpp.macro_indicator.region.description: Geographic scope of the macroeconomic indicator, indicating whether it applies to the United States specifically or to a global aggregate.

lpp.macro_indicator.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.macro_indicator.as_of_date.description: The calendar date as of which the macroeconomic indicator value was observed or reported.

lpp.macro_indicator.value.name: value
lpp.macro_indicator.value.description: The numeric reading of the macroeconomic indicator for the given region and date, expressed in the units specified by the unit column.

lpp.macro_indicator.unit.name: unit
lpp.macro_indicator.unit.description: The unit of measurement for the indicator value, such as percentage (pct), US dollars per barrel (usd_per_bbl), an index number (index), or year-over-year percentage change (pct_yoy).

lpp.macro_indicator.source.name: source
lpp.macro_indicator.source.description: The data provider or institution from which the macroeconomic indicator value was sourced, such as FRED, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (FRBNY), CME Group, ICE, BBAEP, or the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
value_aliases: FRED -> Federal Reserve Economic Data (St. Louis Fed)
FRBNY -> Federal Reserve Bank of New York
BBAEP -> British Bankers' Association Energy Prices

lpp.mapping_entry.mapping_table_code.name: mapping_table_code
lpp.mapping_entry.mapping_table_code.description: Identifies which business mapping table is being referenced, such as rail-to-AFP payment method mapping, flow-to-GL account mapping, bank-to-BIC code mapping, or company-to-functional-currency mapping.
value_aliases: RAIL_TO_AFP -> Payment Rail to AFP Method Mapping
FLOW_TO_GL -> Cash Flow Type to General Ledger Account Mapping
BANK_TO_BIC -> Bank Institution to BIC/SWIFT Code Mapping
CO_TO_FUNCTIONAL_CCY -> Company to Functional Currency Mapping

lpp.mapping_entry.source_value.name: source_value
lpp.mapping_entry.source_value.description: The input value being translated, representing a payment rail, cash flow type, or bank institution code depending on the mapping table context (e.g., WIRE, ACH, SEPA_CT, BANK_JPM).

lpp.mapping_entry.target_value.name: target_value
lpp.mapping_entry.target_value.description: The translated output value resulting from the mapping, which may represent a GL account number, BIC/SWIFT code, currency code, or AFP payment method code depending on the mapping table context.

lpp.mapping_table.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.mapping_table.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each mapping table entry.

lpp.mapping_table.code.name: code
lpp.mapping_table.code.description: Short machine-readable code identifying the type of mapping being defined, such as payment rail to AFP service code or company to functional currency.
value_aliases: RAIL_TO_AFP -> Payment Rail to AFP Service Code
FLOW_TO_GL -> Cash Flow Code to GL Account Class
BANK_TO_BIC -> Internal Bank Code to BIC

lpp.mapping_table.description.name: description
lpp.mapping_table.description.description: Human-readable explanation of the mapping type, describing the source concept and its target classification (e.g., payment rail to AFP service code).

lpp.mapping_table.scope.name: scope
lpp.mapping_table.scope.description: Indicates the organisational applicability of the mapping, with GLOBAL meaning the mapping applies across all entities and regions.

lpp.membership_fee.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.membership_fee.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each membership fee transaction record.

lpp.membership_fee.member_id.name: member_id
lpp.membership_fee.member_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to each member who was charged a membership fee, formatted as MBR- followed by a numeric code.

lpp.membership_fee.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.membership_fee.company_ref.description: Code identifying the regional or national company entity associated with the membership fee, such as GR_US_INC for the US entity or GR_JP for the Japan entity.

lpp.membership_fee.channel.name: channel
lpp.membership_fee.channel.description: The sales or renewal channel through which the membership fee was collected, such as in-warehouse, ecommerce, auto-renewal, mail renewal, or new sign-up.

lpp.membership_fee.membership_tier.name: membership_tier
lpp.membership_fee.membership_tier.description: The tier level of the membership for which the fee was charged, such as Gold, Business, or Executive.

lpp.membership_fee.issued_date.name: issued_date
lpp.membership_fee.issued_date.description: The calendar date on which the membership fee was issued or the membership period began.

lpp.membership_fee.expiration_date.name: expiration_date
lpp.membership_fee.expiration_date.description: The calendar date on which the membership period covered by this fee expires.

lpp.membership_fee.fee_amount.name: fee_amount
lpp.membership_fee.fee_amount.description: The monetary amount charged to the member for the membership fee, with observed values of 65, 120, and 130 corresponding to different membership tiers.

lpp.membership_fee.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.membership_fee.currency_code.description: The ISO currency code in which the membership fee amount is denominated, currently always USD.

lpp.membership_fee.payment_method.name: payment_method
lpp.membership_fee.payment_method.description: The method used by the member to pay the membership fee, currently always card-based payment.

lpp.membership_fee.status.name: status
lpp.membership_fee.status.description: The current collection status of the membership fee transaction, indicating whether it was successfully collected, failed, charged back, or refunded.

lpp.membership_fee.fraud_loss.name: fraud_loss
lpp.membership_fee.fraud_loss.description: The monetary amount of loss attributed to fraud for the membership fee transaction, typically zero but equal to the fee amount when a fraudulent chargeback occurs.

lpp.payment_exception.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.payment_exception.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each payment exception record.

lpp.payment_exception.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.payment_exception.file_uuid.description: Identifier of the payment file associated with this exception.

lpp.payment_exception.transfer_uuid.name: transfer_uuid
lpp.payment_exception.transfer_uuid.description: Identifier of the payment transfer transaction associated with this exception.

lpp.payment_exception.exception_type.name: exception_type
lpp.payment_exception.exception_type.description: Categorizes the root cause of the payment exception, such as bank validation failure, file format error, beneficiary data issue, duplicate payment, OFAC compliance hold, or other.

lpp.payment_exception.detected_at.name: detected_at
lpp.payment_exception.detected_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment exception was first detected.

lpp.payment_exception.resolved_at.name: resolved_at
lpp.payment_exception.resolved_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment exception was fully resolved.

lpp.payment_exception.resolution_time_mi.name: resolution_time_minutes
lpp.payment_exception.resolution_time_mi.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from exception detection to resolution, with observed values ranging from 30 to 120 minutes.

lpp.payment_exception.resolved_by_user.name: resolved_by_user
lpp.payment_exception.resolved_by_user.description: Role or user identifier of the treasury or accounts payable team member who resolved the exception, such as regional cash managers or AP leads.

lpp.payment_exception.resolution_action.name: resolution_action
lpp.payment_exception.resolution_action.description: Action taken to resolve the payment exception, such as an automated repair process.

lpp.payment_exception.repair_touch_count.name: repair_touch_count
lpp.payment_exception.repair_touch_count.description: Number of manual or automated intervention attempts required to repair the payment exception.

lpp.payment_exception.repair_cost_amount.name: repair_cost_amount
lpp.payment_exception.repair_cost_amount.description: Monetary cost incurred to repair or resolve the payment exception.

lpp.payment_exception.status.name: status
lpp.payment_exception.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment exception, indicating whether it has been resolved.

lpp.payment_file.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.payment_file.file_uuid.description: Unique identifier assigned to each payment file record.

lpp.payment_file.file_name.name: file_name
lpp.payment_file.file_name.description: The name of the ISO pain.001 XML payment instruction file generated for a specific account and date, e.g. 'pain001-HQ_INV_EUR-20250604.xml'.

lpp.payment_file.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.payment_file.company_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the legal entity or company that initiated the payment file, such as 'GR_FR' for the French entity or 'GR_TREASURY' for the treasury function.

lpp.payment_file.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.payment_file.account_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the bank account from which the payment file is debited, such as 'HQ_INV_EUR' for the headquarters EUR investment account or 'GR_FR_OPERATING_1' for the French operating account.

lpp.payment_file.status.name: status
lpp.payment_file.status.description: Current processing status of the payment file indicating whether it has been sent to the bank, received, or negatively acknowledged.

lpp.payment_file.routing_status.name: routing_status
lpp.payment_file.routing_status.description: Indicates the routing completion state of the payment file, with 'COMPLETE' signifying the file has been fully routed.

lpp.payment_file.total_count.name: total_count
lpp.payment_file.total_count.description: The total number of individual payment transactions included within the payment file.

lpp.payment_file.total_amount.name: total_amount
lpp.payment_file.total_amount.description: The aggregate monetary value of all payment transactions contained in the payment file, expressed in the file's currency.

lpp.payment_file.total_currency.name: total_currency
lpp.payment_file.total_currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code in which the total amount of the payment file is denominated, such as EUR, USD, or JPY.

lpp.payment_file.created_at.name: created_at
lpp.payment_file.created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the payment file record was first created in the system.

lpp.payment_file.updated_at.name: updated_at
lpp.payment_file.updated_at.description: Timestamp recording the most recent update to the payment file record, reflecting status changes or other modifications.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each payment hub throughput record.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.metric_date.name: metric_date
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.metric_date.description: The calendar date for which the payment throughput metrics are reported.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.payment_rail.name: payment_rail
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.payment_rail.description: The payment network or clearing rail over which transactions were processed, such as ACH, WIRE, RTP, or SEPA Credit Transfer.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.country.name: country
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.country.description: The country in which the payment transactions were originated or settled.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.originating_s.name: originating_system
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.originating_s.description: The upstream platform or application that submitted the payment instructions, such as the Kyriba Payment Hub.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.volume_count.name: volume_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.volume_count.description: The total number of payment transactions submitted for processing on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.value_amount.name: value_amount
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.value_amount.description: The total monetary value of all payment transactions processed on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.success_count.name: success_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.success_count.description: The number of payment transactions that were successfully processed and completed on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.rejection_cou.name: rejection_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.rejection_cou.description: The number of payment transactions that were rejected or failed processing on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.repair_count.name: repair_count
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.repair_count.description: The number of payment transactions that required manual intervention or repair before processing on the metric date.

lpp.payment_hub_throughput.stp_rate_pct.name: stp_rate_pct
lpp.payment_hub_throughput.stp_rate_pct.description: The straight-through processing rate expressed as a percentage, representing the share of payments processed automatically without manual intervention.

lpp.payment_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.payment_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each payment transaction record.

lpp.payment_transaction.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.payment_transaction.file_uuid.description: Identifier of the payment file batch that contained this transaction, linking individual transactions to their originating bulk submission.

lpp.payment_transaction.end_to_end_id.name: end_to_end_id
lpp.payment_transaction.end_to_end_id.description: Industry-standard end-to-end reference code (e.g. E2E-0000055329) that uniquely tracks a payment instruction across all parties from originator to beneficiary.

lpp.payment_transaction.transaction_date.name: transaction_date
lpp.payment_transaction.transaction_date.description: The business date on which the payment transaction was initiated or value-dated.

lpp.payment_transaction.execution_date.name: execution_date
lpp.payment_transaction.execution_date.description: The date on which the payment was actually executed or settled by the bank or payment rail.

lpp.payment_transaction.status.name: status
lpp.payment_transaction.status.description: The final processing outcome of the payment transaction, indicating whether it was successfully completed or declined.

lpp.payment_transaction.reason_code.name: reason_code
lpp.payment_transaction.reason_code.description: Standardised bank rejection reason code (e.g. AC03 indicating invalid creditor account) populated only when a transaction is rejected.

lpp.payment_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.payment_transaction.amount.description: The monetary value of the payment transaction in the specified transaction currency.

lpp.payment_transaction.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.payment_transaction.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code denoting the currency in which the payment amount is denominated (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP).

lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_name.name: issuer_name
lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_name.description: Short code identifying the legal entity within the group that is the originator or payer of the transaction (e.g. GR_FR for the French entity, GR_TREASURY for the treasury entity).

lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_account.name: issuer_account
lpp.payment_transaction.issuer_account.description: Internal label for the specific bank account of the issuing entity from which the payment is debited (e.g. GR_FR_OPERATING_1, GR_US_INC_PAYROLL_1).

lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_nam.name: counterparty_name
lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_nam.description: The name or category of the external beneficiary receiving the payment, such as Vendor, Payroll Provider, Tax Authority, or Landlord Holdings.

lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_acc.name: counterparty_account
lpp.payment_transaction.counterparty_acc.description: Internal reference code identifying the specific bank account of the beneficiary receiving the payment (e.g. TP_CAPEX_0001, TP_IT_0004).

lpp.payment_transaction.reference.name: reference
lpp.payment_transaction.reference.description: Business reference number assigned to the payment by the originating system, such as an accounts-payable invoice reference (AP-XXXXXXXX) or a tax payment reference (TAX-...).

lpp.payment_transaction.last_ack_time.name: last_ack_time
lpp.payment_transaction.last_ack_time.description: Timestamp of the most recent acknowledgement received from the bank or payment network confirming receipt or final status of the transaction.

lpp.payment_transaction.payment_rail.name: payment_rail
lpp.payment_transaction.payment_rail.description: The payment network or clearing mechanism used to route the transaction, such as SEPA Credit Transfer, international wire, ACH, or Real-Time Payments.

lpp.peer_company.code.name: code
lpp.peer_company.code.description: Unique internal code identifying a peer company, typically matching its stock ticker symbol (e.g., WMT, TGT, AMZN).

lpp.peer_company.name.name: name
lpp.peer_company.name.description: Full legal or commonly recognized business name of the peer company (e.g., Walmart Inc., Amazon.com Inc.).

lpp.peer_company.ticker.name: ticker
lpp.peer_company.ticker.description: Stock exchange ticker symbol used to identify the peer company on public markets (e.g., WMT, HD, AMZN).

lpp.peer_company.sector.name: sector
lpp.peer_company.sector.description: Broad industry sector classification of the peer company, such as Consumer Staples Retail or Consumer Discretionary / Cloud.

lpp.peer_company.peer_group.name: peer_group
lpp.peer_company.peer_group.description: Categorical grouping that clusters peer companies into competitive segments such as big-box retail, grocery, or e-commerce.

lpp.peer_company.country.name: country
lpp.peer_company.country.description: Country of domicile or primary operations for the peer company, currently limited to the United States (US).

lpp.peer_company_metric.peer_code.name: peer_code
lpp.peer_company_metric.peer_code.description: Stock ticker symbol identifying the peer competitor company (e.g., WMT for Walmart, TGT for Target, AMZN for Amazon).

lpp.peer_company_metric.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.peer_company_metric.period_date.description: The calendar date marking the end of the reporting period for the peer company metrics.

lpp.peer_company_metric.period_type.name: period_type
lpp.peer_company_metric.period_type.description: Indicates whether the reported metrics cover a quarterly or full fiscal year period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.reporting_curren.name: reporting_currency
lpp.peer_company_metric.reporting_curren.description: The ISO currency code in which the peer company's financial metrics are reported (e.g., USD).

lpp.peer_company_metric.revenue.name: revenue
lpp.peer_company_metric.revenue.description: Total net revenue or sales generated by the peer company during the reporting period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.ebitda.name: ebitda
lpp.peer_company_metric.ebitda.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization reported by the peer company for the period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.free_cash_flow.name: free_cash_flow
lpp.peer_company_metric.free_cash_flow.description: Cash generated by the peer company after capital expenditures, available for distribution or reinvestment.

lpp.peer_company_metric.net_debt.name: net_debt
lpp.peer_company_metric.net_debt.description: Total financial debt of the peer company minus cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.leverage_ratio.name: leverage_ratio
lpp.peer_company_metric.leverage_ratio.description: A ratio measuring the peer company's total debt relative to its earnings or equity, indicating financial leverage.

lpp.peer_company_metric.debt_to_ebitda.name: debt_to_ebitda
lpp.peer_company_metric.debt_to_ebitda.description: Ratio of the peer company's net debt to EBITDA, used to assess its ability to service debt from operating earnings.

lpp.peer_company_metric.return_on_capita.name: return_on_capital_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.return_on_capita.description: Percentage return the peer company earns on its invested capital during the reporting period.

lpp.peer_company_metric.dividend_yield_p.name: dividend_yield_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.dividend_yield_p.description: Annual dividend paid by the peer company expressed as a percentage of its share price.

lpp.peer_company_metric.buyback_yield_pc.name: buyback_yield_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.buyback_yield_pc.description: Value of share repurchases conducted by the peer company expressed as a percentage of its market capitalization.

lpp.peer_company_metric.shareholder_retu.name: shareholder_return_yield_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.shareholder_retu.description: Combined yield returned to shareholders by the peer company through both dividends and share buybacks.

lpp.peer_company_metric.wacc_pct.name: wacc_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.wacc_pct.description: Weighted average cost of capital for the peer company, reflecting the blended required rate of return across debt and equity.

lpp.peer_company_metric.payments_cost_pc.name: payments_cost_pct_revenue
lpp.peer_company_metric.payments_cost_pc.description: Total payments processing and acceptance costs incurred by the peer company expressed as a percentage of revenue.

lpp.peer_company_metric.fraud_loss_bps.name: fraud_loss_bps
lpp.peer_company_metric.fraud_loss_bps.description: Fraud-related financial losses incurred by the peer company measured in basis points relative to payment volume or revenue.

lpp.peer_company_metric.interchange_pct.name: interchange_pct
lpp.peer_company_metric.interchange_pct.description: Interchange fees paid or earned by the peer company on card transactions expressed as a percentage of transaction volume.

lpp.pension_plan.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.pension_plan.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each pension plan record.

lpp.pension_plan.code.name: code
lpp.pension_plan.code.description: Short alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a pension plan, encoding country and plan type (e.g., PP_US_DB for the US defined-benefit plan).

lpp.pension_plan.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.pension_plan.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary of the company that sponsors the pension plan (e.g., GR_US_INC for the US incorporated entity).

lpp.pension_plan.plan_name.name: plan_name
lpp.pension_plan.plan_name.description: Full descriptive name of the pension plan as used in official plan documentation (e.g., GlobalRetail UK Pension Scheme).

lpp.pension_plan.plan_type.name: plan_type
lpp.pension_plan.plan_type.description: Classification of the pension plan structure, indicating whether it is a defined benefit, hybrid, or other arrangement.

lpp.pension_plan.country.name: country
lpp.pension_plan.country.description: ISO country code indicating the jurisdiction in which the pension plan operates (e.g., US, GB, JP).

lpp.pension_plan.open_to_new_participant.name: open_to_new_participants
lpp.pension_plan.open_to_new_participant.description: Flag indicating whether the pension plan is currently accepting new employee enrolments.

lpp.pension_valuation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.pension_valuation.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each pension valuation record for system-level deduplication and reference.

lpp.pension_valuation.plan_ref.name: plan_ref
lpp.pension_valuation.plan_ref.description: Unique code identifying the defined-benefit pension plan, including the sponsoring entity's country and plan type (e.g., PP_US_DB for the US defined-benefit plan).

lpp.pension_valuation.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.pension_valuation.as_of_date.description: The measurement date as of which the pension valuation figures are calculated and reported.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_benefit_.name: projected_benefit_obligation
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_benefit_.description: The actuarially determined present value of all future pension benefits earned by employees to date, including projected future salary increases.

lpp.pension_valuation.plan_assets_fair_v.name: plan_assets_fair_value
lpp.pension_valuation.plan_assets_fair_v.description: The fair market value of assets held in the pension trust fund to fund future benefit obligations.

lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status.name: funded_status
lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status.description: The net pension position representing the difference between plan assets at fair value and the projected benefit obligation, where a positive value indicates an overfunded plan and a negative value indicates an underfunded plan.

lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status_pct.name: funded_status_pct
lpp.pension_valuation.funded_status_pct.description: The pension plan's funding level expressed as a percentage, representing plan assets as a proportion of the projected benefit obligation.

lpp.pension_valuation.discount_rate_pct.name: discount_rate_pct
lpp.pension_valuation.discount_rate_pct.description: The actuarial discount rate used to calculate the present value of future pension benefit obligations, expressed as a percentage.

lpp.pension_valuation.expected_return_on.name: expected_return_on_assets_pct
lpp.pension_valuation.expected_return_on.description: The long-term expected annual rate of return on pension plan assets, expressed as a percentage, used as an actuarial assumption in the net pension cost calculation.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.name: projected_contribution_y1
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.description: The forecasted cash contribution the company expects to make to the pension plan in the first projected year.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.name: projected_contribution_y2
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.description: The forecasted cash contribution the company expects to make to the pension plan in the second projected year.

lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.name: projected_contribution_y3
lpp.pension_valuation.projected_contribu.description: The forecasted cash contribution the company expects to make to the pension plan in the third projected year.

lpp.pension_valuation.oci_impact.name: oci_impact
lpp.pension_valuation.oci_impact.description: The net actuarial gains or losses and prior service costs recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) related to the pension plan for the valuation period.

lpp.pension_valuation.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.pension_valuation.currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the pension plan's monetary values are denominated.

lpp.pos_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.pos_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each point-of-sale transaction record.

lpp.pos_transaction.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.pos_transaction.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or country-specific subsidiary that processed the transaction (e.g., GR_JP for the Japan entity, GR_US_INC for the US entity).

lpp.pos_transaction.channel.name: channel
lpp.pos_transaction.channel.description: Sales channel through which the transaction was conducted, such as in-warehouse, e-commerce, mobile app, kiosk, or membership renewal.

lpp.pos_transaction.location_code.name: location_code
lpp.pos_transaction.location_code.description: Identifier for the physical warehouse or store location where the transaction occurred, formatted as WH_{country}_{number} (e.g., WH_US_0039); null for non-physical channels.

lpp.pos_transaction.transaction_ts.name: transaction_ts
lpp.pos_transaction.transaction_ts.description: Exact date and time (with timezone) at which the point-of-sale transaction was recorded.

lpp.pos_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.pos_transaction.amount.description: Monetary value of the transaction in the associated currency.

lpp.pos_transaction.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.pos_transaction.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the transaction amount is denominated (e.g., JPY, USD, GBP).

lpp.pos_transaction.payment_method.name: payment_method
lpp.pos_transaction.payment_method.description: Method used by the customer to pay for the transaction, such as card, cash, mobile wallet, check, or gift card.

lpp.pos_transaction.member_id.name: member_id
lpp.pos_transaction.member_id.description: Unique identifier for the membership account associated with the transaction; null when the transaction is not linked to a member.

lpp.pos_transaction.register_id.name: register_id
lpp.pos_transaction.register_id.description: Identifier for the physical or virtual register terminal that processed the transaction (e.g., REG-04).

lpp.sme_feedback_session.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sme_feedback_session.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each SME feedback session record.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.sme_user.name: sme_user
lpp.sme_feedback_session.sme_user.description: The subject matter expert (SME) who participated in the feedback session.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.interviewer_use.name: interviewer_user
lpp.sme_feedback_session.interviewer_use.description: The user who conducted or facilitated the feedback session as the interviewer.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.started_at.name: started_at
lpp.sme_feedback_session.started_at.description: The date and time when the SME feedback session began.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.ended_at.name: ended_at
lpp.sme_feedback_session.ended_at.description: The date and time when the SME feedback session concluded.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.topic.name: topic
lpp.sme_feedback_session.topic.description: The subject or theme that was discussed during the SME feedback session.

lpp.sme_feedback_session.transcript_uri.name: transcript_uri
lpp.sme_feedback_session.transcript_uri.description: The URI or file path pointing to the stored transcript of the feedback session.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each transcript chunk record.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.session_uuid.name: session_uuid
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.session_uuid.description: Unique identifier referencing the SME session to which this transcript chunk belongs.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.chunk_index.name: chunk_index
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.chunk_index.description: Sequential position of this text chunk within its parent session transcript, used to preserve reading order.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.text.name: text
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.text.description: The actual transcribed text content of this chunk from the SME session.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.opensearch_doc_.name: opensearch_doc_id
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.opensearch_doc_.description: The document identifier assigned to this chunk in the OpenSearch index, used for vector search retrieval.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedding_model.name: embedding_model
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedding_model.description: The name or version of the machine learning model used to generate the vector embedding for this transcript chunk.

lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedded_at.name: embedded_at
lpp.sme_transcript_chunk.embedded_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the vector embedding was generated and stored for this transcript chunk.

lpp.stress_run_result.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.stress_run_result.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each individual stress test run result record.

lpp.stress_run_result.scenario_ref.name: scenario_ref
