lpp.stress_run_result.scenario_ref.description: Code identifying the specific stress scenario applied in the run, such as an accounts-receivable drop, bank downgrade, top customer default, FX shock, or interest rate shift.

lpp.stress_run_result.run_date.name: run_date
lpp.stress_run_result.run_date.description: The date on which the stress test was executed, aligned to month-end timestamps.

lpp.stress_run_result.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.stress_run_result.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary for which the stress test result was produced.

lpp.stress_run_result.breach_date.name: breach_date
lpp.stress_run_result.breach_date.description: The projected date on which the entity's cash position is expected to breach the minimum threshold under the stress scenario; null when no breach is projected.

lpp.stress_run_result.min_projected_cash.name: min_projected_cash
lpp.stress_run_result.min_projected_cash.description: The lowest projected cash balance for the entity over the stress scenario horizon, expressed in the reporting currency.

lpp.stress_run_result.threshold_amount.name: threshold_amount
lpp.stress_run_result.threshold_amount.description: The minimum cash balance threshold against which the stress scenario result is evaluated, currently set at 400 million.

lpp.stress_run_result.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.stress_run_result.currency_code.description: The ISO currency code in which all monetary values in the stress run result are expressed, currently USD.

lpp.stress_run_result.breach_severity.name: breach_severity
lpp.stress_run_result.breach_severity.description: Categorical indicator of whether the stress scenario results in a threshold breach, with values of NONE for no breach or WARNING for a projected breach.

lpp.stress_scenario.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.stress_scenario.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each stress scenario record.

lpp.stress_scenario.code.name: code
lpp.stress_scenario.code.description: Short machine-readable code uniquely identifying a stress scenario, such as a receivables drop, FX shock, or rate shift (e.g., STR_AR_DROP_20, STR_FX_USD_PLUS_10).
value_aliases: STR_AR_DROP_30_60D -> AR Receipts Drop 30% for 60 Days

lpp.stress_scenario.description.name: description
lpp.stress_scenario.description.description: Human-readable narrative explaining the stress event and its assumed magnitude and duration (e.g., 'AR receipts drop 20% for 30 days').

lpp.stress_scenario.scenario_type.name: scenario_type
lpp.stress_scenario.scenario_type.description: Categorical classification of the stress scenario by the type of risk shock applied, such as receipts drop, FX shock, rate shock, customer default, or bank downgrade.

lpp.stress_scenario.parameters.name: parameters
lpp.stress_scenario.parameters.description: Structured JSON object containing the specific quantitative and qualitative parameters that define how the stress scenario is applied (e.g., shock magnitude, affected instruments, duration).

lpp.stress_scenario.created_at.name: created_at
lpp.stress_scenario.created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the stress scenario definition was first created in the system.

lpp.sweep_execution.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sweep_execution.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each sweep execution record.

lpp.sweep_execution.instruction_ref.name: instruction_ref
lpp.sweep_execution.instruction_ref.description: Reference code identifying the sweep instruction rule that triggered this execution, encoding region, entity, account type, and sequence (e.g. SW_GR_US_INC_OP_2).

lpp.sweep_execution.execution_date.name: execution_date
lpp.sweep_execution.execution_date.description: Calendar date on which the sweep was executed.

lpp.sweep_execution.source_account_ref.name: source_account_ref
lpp.sweep_execution.source_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the source account from which funds were swept (e.g. GR_US_INC_OP_2 representing a specific operating account).

lpp.sweep_execution.target_account_ref.name: target_account_ref
lpp.sweep_execution.target_account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the destination concentration or investment account to which swept funds were transferred.

lpp.sweep_execution.swept_amount.name: swept_amount
lpp.sweep_execution.swept_amount.description: The monetary amount transferred from the source account to the target account during the sweep execution.

lpp.sweep_execution.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.sweep_execution.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code denoting the currency in which the sweep was executed (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.sweep_execution.pre_sweep_balance.name: pre_sweep_balance
lpp.sweep_execution.pre_sweep_balance.description: The account balance in the source account immediately before the sweep was executed.

lpp.sweep_execution.post_sweep_balance.name: post_sweep_balance
lpp.sweep_execution.post_sweep_balance.description: The account balance in the source account immediately after the sweep was executed.

lpp.sweep_execution.residual_amount.name: residual_amount
lpp.sweep_execution.residual_amount.description: The monetary amount intentionally left behind in the source account after the sweep, such as a required minimum or target balance (commonly zero but can be a fixed threshold like 200,000).

lpp.sweep_execution.status.name: status
lpp.sweep_execution.status.description: Outcome status of the sweep execution indicating whether it was successfully completed, failed, or deliberately skipped.

lpp.sweep_execution.cash_flow_uuid.name: cash_flow_uuid
lpp.sweep_execution.cash_flow_uuid.description: Unique identifier referencing the outbound cash flow record generated by this sweep execution.

lpp.sweep_execution.counter_cash_flow_uu.name: counter_cash_flow_uuid
lpp.sweep_execution.counter_cash_flow_uu.description: Unique identifier referencing the corresponding inbound counter cash flow record on the target account side of the sweep.

lpp.sweep_instruction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.sweep_instruction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each sweep instruction record.

lpp.sweep_instruction.code.name: code
lpp.sweep_instruction.code.description: Business code uniquely identifying a sweep instruction, encoding the sweep type, entity group, country, and account sequence (e.g., SW_GR_GB_OPERATING_1).

lpp.sweep_instruction.source_account_ref.name: source_account_ref
lpp.sweep_instruction.source_account_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the account from which funds are swept, representing a specific operating or regional account.

lpp.sweep_instruction.target_account_ref.name: target_account_ref
lpp.sweep_instruction.target_account_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the destination concentration or regional account into which swept funds are deposited.

lpp.sweep_instruction.sweep_type.name: sweep_type
lpp.sweep_instruction.sweep_type.description: Classification of the cash sweep mechanism used for the instruction, such as zero-balance, target balance, notional pooling, or threshold-based.

lpp.sweep_instruction.direction.name: direction
lpp.sweep_instruction.direction.description: Indicates whether the sweep moves funds only upward to the target account or operates bidirectionally between source and target.

lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance.name: target_balance
lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance.description: The desired residual balance amount to maintain in the source account after the sweep is executed.

lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance_ccy.name: target_balance_ccy
lpp.sweep_instruction.target_balance_ccy.description: ISO currency code denoting the currency in which the target balance amount is expressed.

lpp.sweep_instruction.threshold_amount.name: threshold_amount
lpp.sweep_instruction.threshold_amount.description: The minimum balance threshold that must be exceeded in the source account before a threshold-based sweep is triggered.

lpp.sweep_instruction.schedule_cron.name: schedule_cron
lpp.sweep_instruction.schedule_cron.description: Schedule expression defining when the sweep instruction is executed, with the observed value indicating end-of-day processing.

lpp.sweep_instruction.priority.name: priority
lpp.sweep_instruction.priority.description: Numeric priority order controlling the sequence in which sweep instructions are executed relative to others.

lpp.sweep_instruction.active.name: active
lpp.sweep_instruction.active.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sweep instruction is currently active and eligible for execution.

lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_from.description: The date from which the sweep instruction becomes valid and can be applied.

lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.sweep_instruction.effective_to.description: The date on which the sweep instruction expires and is no longer valid, with null indicating an open-ended instruction.

lpp.third_party.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.third_party.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier serving as the primary key for each third-party record.

lpp.third_party.code.name: code
lpp.third_party.code.description: Business short code uniquely identifying each third party, such as a retail consumer aggregate or a numbered customer partner (e.g., RETAIL_CONSUMER, TP_CUST_0001).

lpp.third_party.third_party_type.name: third_party_type
lpp.third_party.third_party_type.description: Classification of the third party indicating whether it is an individual or an organization; currently all records are of type ORGANIZATION.

lpp.third_party.name.name: name
lpp.third_party.name.description: Full display name of the third party, such as a retail partner or manufacturing entity (e.g., Macys Partner 1, Casablanca Apparel Mfg 80).

lpp.third_party.name2.name: name2
lpp.third_party.name2.description: Secondary or alternative name for the third party, used when a second line of naming is required.

lpp.third_party.first_name.name: first_name
lpp.third_party.first_name.description: First name of the individual contact associated with the third party, applicable when the party represents a person.

lpp.third_party.last_name.name: last_name
lpp.third_party.last_name.description: Last name of the individual contact associated with the third party, applicable when the party represents a person.

lpp.third_party.birth_date.name: birth_date
lpp.third_party.birth_date.description: Date of birth of the individual associated with the third party, relevant for person-type parties.

lpp.third_party.hidden.name: hidden
lpp.third_party.hidden.description: Flag indicating whether the third party record is hidden from standard views or user interfaces.

lpp.third_party.closure_date.name: closure_date
lpp.third_party.closure_date.description: Date on which the third party relationship was formally closed or the account was deactivated.

lpp.third_party.creditor.name: creditor
lpp.third_party.creditor.description: Flag indicating whether the third party is classified as a creditor (i.e., the company owes money to this party).

lpp.third_party.debtor.name: debtor
lpp.third_party.debtor.description: Flag indicating whether the third party is classified as a debtor (i.e., this party owes money to the company).

lpp.third_party.non_resident.name: non_resident
lpp.third_party.non_resident.description: Flag indicating whether the third party is classified as a non-resident entity for tax or regulatory purposes.

lpp.third_party.corp_id_code.name: corp_id_code
lpp.third_party.corp_id_code.description: Official corporate identification code or registration number assigned to the third party by a government or regulatory authority.

lpp.third_party.other_identifier.name: other_identifier
lpp.third_party.other_identifier.description: Structured JSON object capturing additional or alternative identifiers for the third party beyond the standard fields.

lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_id.name: creditor_tax_id
lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_id.description: Tax identification number assigned to the third party in their role as a creditor for fiscal reporting purposes.

lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_registratio.name: creditor_tax_registration_id
lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_registratio.description: VAT or tax registration identifier for the third party acting as a creditor, used for invoicing and compliance.

lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_type.name: creditor_tax_type
lpp.third_party.creditor_tax_type.description: Classification of the tax regime or tax category applicable to the third party in their role as a creditor.

lpp.third_party.creditor_agent_instructi.name: creditor_agent_instruction
lpp.third_party.creditor_agent_instructi.description: Special payment or handling instructions provided to the banking agent when processing payments to this creditor.

lpp.third_party.link_number_ref.name: link_number_ref
lpp.third_party.link_number_ref.description: Reference code linking the third party to an associated record or group in an external or internal system.

lpp.third_party.portfolio_ref.name: portfolio_ref
lpp.third_party.portfolio_ref.description: Reference to the portfolio with which this third party is associated for grouping or management purposes.

lpp.third_party.folder_ref.name: folder_ref
lpp.third_party.folder_ref.description: Reference to the organizational folder or filing category under which this third party record is grouped.

lpp.third_party.limit_currency_ref.name: limit_currency_ref
lpp.third_party.limit_currency_ref.description: Currency code in which transaction limits for this third party are expressed, currently EUR for all records.

lpp.third_party.transaction_entry_limit.name: transaction_entry_limit
lpp.third_party.transaction_entry_limit.description: Maximum monetary amount allowed per individual transaction entry for this third party, expressed in the limit currency.

lpp.third_party.transaction_max_number.name: transaction_max_number
lpp.third_party.transaction_max_number.description: Maximum number of transactions permitted for this third party within a given period.

lpp.third_party.company_selection.name: company_selection
lpp.third_party.company_selection.description: Rule or scope defining which companies within the organization are permitted to transact with this third party.

lpp.third_party.used_by_company_ref.name: used_by_company_ref
lpp.third_party.used_by_company_ref.description: Reference to the primary company that uses or manages this third party relationship.

lpp.third_party.used_by_companies.name: used_by_companies
lpp.third_party.used_by_companies.description: Structured list of all companies within the organization that have access to or use this third party record.

lpp.third_party.company_ownership_ref.name: company_ownership_ref
lpp.third_party.company_ownership_ref.description: Reference to the company that owns or has primary responsibility for this third party record.

lpp.third_party.address.name: address
lpp.third_party.address.description: Structured JSON object containing the postal or physical address details of the third party.

lpp.third_party.contact.name: contact
lpp.third_party.contact.description: Structured JSON object storing contact information such as phone numbers or email addresses for the third party.

lpp.third_party.memo.name: memo
lpp.third_party.memo.description: Free-text notes or remarks associated with the third party for internal reference purposes.

lpp.third_party.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.third_party.user_zones.description: Structured JSON object defining custom user-defined classification zones or segmentation attributes for the third party.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.third_party_bank_account.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each third-party bank account record.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.third_party.name: third_party_code
lpp.third_party_bank_account.third_party.description: Code identifying the external third party (e.g., vendor, supplier, or counterparty) that owns this bank account.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.branch_ref.name: branch_ref
lpp.third_party_bank_account.branch_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank branch associated with this third-party bank account.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.currency_re.name: currency_ref
lpp.third_party_bank_account.currency_re.description: Currency code indicating the denomination in which this third-party bank account operates.

lpp.third_party_bank_account.bank_accoun.name: bank_account_id
